Title: 1. The Jungle Book
description: Bagheera the Panther and Baloo the Bear have a difficult time trying to convince a boy to leave the jungle for human civilization.

Title: 2. The Graduate
description: A disillusioned college graduate finds himself torn between his older lover and her daughter.

Title: 3. Guess Who's Coming to Dinner
description: A White couple's attitudes are challenged when their daughter introduces them to her Black fiancé.

Title: 4. You Only Live Twice
description: James Bond and the Japanese Secret Service must find and stop the true culprit of a series of space hijackings, before war is provoked between Russia and the United States.

Title: 5. Belle de Jour
description: A frigid young housewife decides to spend her midweek afternoons as a prostitute.

Title: 6. The Producers
description: A stage-play producer devises a plan to make money by producing a sure-fire flop.

Title: 7. Le Samouraï
description: After professional hitman Jef Costello is seen by witnesses, his efforts to provide himself an alibi drive him further into a corner.

Title: 8. 2 or 3 Things I Know About Her
description: A day in the life of a Parisian housewife/prostitute, interspersed with musings on the Vietnam War and other contemporary issues.

Title: 9. The Young Girls of Rochefort
description: Two sisters leave their small seaside town of Rochefort in search of romance. Hired as carnival singers, one falls for an American musician, while the other must search for her ideal partner.

Title: 10. The Two of Us
description: In German-occupied France, a Jewish child is sent away from his family and conceals his religious affiliation from the anti-Semitic elderly man that takes care of him.

Title: 11. The Chinese
description: A small group of French students are studying Mao, trying to find out their position in the world and how to change the world to a Maoistic community using terrorism.

Title: 12. Accident
description: A beautiful Austrian coed attending Oxford University is betrothed to a fellow student, but she ends up getting involved with two unhappily married professors instead.

Title: 13. Far from Vietnam
description: In seven different segments, Godard, Klein, Lelouch, Marker, Resnais, and Varda show their sympathy and support for the North Vietnamese army during the Vietnam War.

Title: 14. A Man Vanishes
description: Plastics salesman Oshima disappeared without a word to anyone, and has been missing for two years. Shohei Imamura and his crew follow Oshima's fiancé Yoshie and actor Shigeru Tsuyuguchi as they investigate the disappearance.

Title: 15. Point Blank
description: After being double-crossed and left for dead, a mysterious man named Walker single-mindedly tries to retrieve the money that was stolen from him.

Title: 16. Bonnie and Clyde
description: Bored waitress Bonnie Parker falls in love with an ex-con named Clyde Barrow and together they start a murderous cross-country crime spree stealing cars and robbing banks.

Title: 17. In the Heat of the Night
description: A black Philadelphia police detective is mistakenly suspected of a local murder while passing through a racially hostile Mississippi town, and after being cleared is reluctantly asked by the police chief to investigate the case.

Title: 18. Cool Hand Luke
description: A laid-back Southern man is sentenced to two years in a rural prison, but refuses to conform.

Title: 19. The Dirty Dozen
description: During World War II, a rebellious U.S. Army Major is assigned a dozen convicted murderers to train and lead them into a mass assassination mission of German officers.

Title: 20. Playtime
description: Monsieur Hulot curiously wanders around a high-tech Paris, paralleling a trip with a group of American tourists. Meanwhile, a nightclub/restaurant prepares its opening night, but it's still under construction.

Title: 21. Wait Until Dark
description: A recently blinded woman is terrorized by a trio of thugs while they search for a heroin-stuffed doll they believe is in her apartment.

Title: 22. To Sir, with Love
description: An idealistic black teacher takes on a temporary position teaching a group of rambunctious white high school students.

Title: 23. Valley of the Dolls
description: Film version of Jacqueline Susann's best-selling novel chronicling the rise and fall of three young women in show business.

Title: 24. The Fearless Vampire Killers
description: A noted professor and his dim-witted apprentice fall prey to their inquiring vampires, while on the trail of the ominous damsel in distress.

Title: 25. Viy
description: A young priest is ordered to preside over the wake of witch in a small old wooden church of a remote village. This means spending three nights alone with the corpse with only his faith to protect him.

Title: 26. In Cold Blood
description: Two ex-cons murder a family in a robbery attempt before going on the run from the authorities who try to piece together the details of the murder in an attempt to track down the killers.

Title: 27. Casino Royale
description: In an early spy spoof, aging Sir James Bond comes out of retirement to take on SMERSH.

Title: 28. Torture Garden
description: An anthology of four short horror stories about people who visit Dr. Diabolo's fairground haunted-house attraction show.

Title: 29. Barefoot in the Park
description: A conservative young lawyer and a free-spirited woman get married after a whirlwind romance, but life in their rundown five-flight NYC walk-up makes them question whether they're right for each other.

Title: 30. Marketa Lazarová
description: A grim portrayal of the shift from Paganism to Christianity in medieval central Europe - as a young virgin promised to God is kidnapped and raped by a marauder who her religious father seeks to kill in return.

Title: 31. The Deadly Affair
description: A British agent sets out to uncover the hidden facts behind a British government employee's suicide.

Title: 32. The Night of the Generals
description: In 1942, a Polish prostitute and German Agent is murdered in Warsaw. Suspicion falls on three Generals, and Major Grau of German Intelligence seeks justice which ends up taking decades.

Title: 33. Five Million Years to Earth
description: A mysterious artifact is unearthed in London, and famous scientist Bernard Quatermass is called in to divine its origins and explain its strange effects on people.

Title: 34. Samurai Rebellion
description: The mother of a feudal lord's only heir is kidnapped away from her husband by the lord. The husband and his samurai father must decide whether to accept the unjust decision, or risk death to get her back.

Title: 35. Mouchette
description: A young girl living in the French countryside suffers constant indignities at the hand of alcoholism and her fellow man.

Title: 36. Death Rides a Horse
description: A young gunfighter bent on killing the four bandits who raped and murdered his family crosses paths with a former outlaw, who hopes to extort the same men in revenge for getting him jailed.

Title: 37. Deadlier Than the Male
description: British agent Bulldog Drummond is assigned to stop a master criminal who uses beautiful women to do his killings.

Title: 38. The War Wagon
description: The story of a man who was shot, robbed and imprisoned who returns to steal a large gold shipment from the man who wronged him. The gold is transported in an armored stage coach, the War Wagon.

Title: 39. The Collector
description: A womanizing art dealer and a painter find the serenity of their Riviera vacation disturbed by a third guest, a vivacious bohemian woman known for her long list of male conquests.

Title: 40. The Firemen's Ball
description: A volunteer fire department throws a party for their former boss with the whole town invited, but nothing goes as planned.

Title: 41. The Stranger
description: A man faces a trial for murder. The court is biased because of his personal qualities.

Title: 42. Branded to Kill
description: After a botched assignment, a rice-fetishizing hitman finds himself in conflict with his organization, and one mysterious, dangerous fellow-hitman in particular.

Title: 43. Who's That Knocking at My Door
description: A young man can't accept the girl he likes because of her bitter past.

Title: 44. The Trip
description: A disillusioned, soon-to-be divorced TV commercial director is guided by his friend through an LSD trip, during which he evaluates his identity and his relationships with women.

Title: 45. Oedipus Rex
description: Rescued from abandonment and raised by the King and Queen, Oedipus is still haunted by a prophecy--he'll murder his father and marry his mother.

Title: 46. Two for the Road
description: A couple in the south of France non-sequentially spin down the highways of infidelity in their troubled ten-year marriage.

Title: 47. Berserk
description: A scheming circus owner finds her authority challenged when a vicious killer targets the show.

Title: 48. The Big Gundown
description: A veteran bounty hunter and would-be senator is tasked by a railroad baron with hunting down a crafty, knife-wielding Mexican peasant accused of the rape-and-murder of a young girl.

Title: 49. Bob Dylan: Dont Look Back
description: Documentary covering Bob Dylan's 1965 tour of England, which includes appearances by Joan Baez and Donovan.

Title: 50. Bedazzled
description: A hapless loser sells his soul to the Devil in exchange for seven wishes, but has trouble winning over the girl of his dreams.

Title: 51. The Taming of the Shrew
description: Brutish, fortune-hunting scoundrel Petruchio tames his wealthy, shrewish wife, Katharina.

Title: 52. Entranced Earth
description: In the fictional Latin American country Eldorado, a poet tries to effect political change by influencing powerful men.

Title: 53. Spider Baby or, The Maddest Story Ever Told
description: A household of cannibals take drastic measures when distant relatives question their sanity.

Title: 54. Hour of the Gun
description: Marshal Wyatt Earp kills a couple of men of the Clanton gang in a fight. In revenge, Clanton's thugs kill the Marshal's brother. Thus, Wyatt starts to chase the killers together with his friend Doc Holliday.

Title: 55. Titicut Follies
description: Documentary filmmaker Frederick Wiseman takes us inside the Massachusetts Correctional Institution Bridgewater, where people stay trapped in their madness.

Title: 56. They Came from Beyond Space
description: Scientists investigating an unusual meteor shower in a rural field are possessed by an alien force bent on an ulterior purpose.

Title: 57. Hombre
description: John Russell, disdained by his "respectable" fellow stagecoach passengers because he was raised by Apaches becomes their only hope for survival when they are set upon by outlaws.

Title: 58. Frankenstein Created Woman
description: After being reanimated, Baron Frankenstein transfers the soul of an executed young man into the body of his lover, prompting her to kill the men who wronged them.

Title: 59. In Like Flint
description: Super-spy Flint takes on a cabal of women plotting to rule the world.

Title: 60. The Shuttered Room
description: A series of horrific murders is traced to a creature that inhabits a very strange house.

Title: 61. Kidnapping, Caucasian Style
description: A young student Shurik comes to a remote mountainous region in search of ancient legends and traditions. Fooled by the corrupt local governor, he helps him to kidnap a beautiful young girl, but soon realizes what he's done.

Title: 62. Face to Face
description: A history professor has a chance meeting with an infamous outlaw and eventually assumes leadership of his gang.

Title: 63. Camelot
description: The story of the marriage of England's King Arthur to Guinevere. The plot of the illegitimate Mordred to gain the throne and Guinevere's growing attachment to Sir Lancelot threaten to topple Arthur and destroy his "Round Table" of knights.

Title: 64. Thoroughly Modern Millie
description: In New York City during the Jazz Age, would-be flapper Millie Dillmount's self-appointed mission to marry her boss is complicated by white slavers and true love.

Title: 65. Doctor Dolittle
description: After the animal communicating veterinarian goes too far for his clientele, he and his friends escape their hometown to the sea in search of the Great Pink Sea Snail.

Title: 66. Mad Monster Party?
description: On the Isle of Evil, Baron Boris von Frankenstein reveals his imminent retirement and that he has refined the secret of total destruction, only to be upset when the other monsters try to steal the secret and kill his nephew, Felix Flanken.

Title: 67. A Countess from Hong Kong
description: In Hong Kong, an ambassador returning to America meets a Russian countess, a refugee without a passport, who decides to hide in his cabin.

Title: 68. The Born Losers
description: Billy Jack battles a motorcycle gang in a small California beach town.

Title: 69. A Bullet for the General
description: A band of Mexican gunrunners employed by a revolutionary General accept an American mercenary into their gang, unaware of his true intentions.

Title: 70. Fitzwilly
description: An elderly woman's butler leads servants in larceny to support her illusion of wealth.

Title: 71. Billion Dollar Brain
description: British spy-turned-detective Harry Palmer stumbles upon an oil tycoon's plot to overthrow Communism using a supercomputer.

Title: 72. Son of Godzilla
description: A reporter stumbles upon weather experiments on a tropical island, discovering giant mantises, a castaway woman, and an infant monster that Godzilla must adopt as his own.

Title: 73. Weekend
description: A surreal tale of a married couple going on a road trip to visit the wife's parents with the intention of killing them for the inheritance.

Title: 74. Hillbillys in a Haunted House
description: A trio of country singers becomes stranded at a haunted mansion and gets mixed up with spies.

Title: 75. Tony Rome
description: Tough Miami P.I. Tony Rome's hired by a millionaire to find jewelry stolen from his daughter. In the search, he has several encounters with local hoods as well as the Miami police.

Title: 76. The Flim-Flam Man
description: A rural con artist and an army deserter cheat the townsfolk and are aided by a rich gal who shields the fleeing duo from the wrath of the pursuing sheriff.

Title: 77. The Last Adventure
description: Best friends become aware of a crashed plane lying on the bottom of the ocean, allegedly stuffed with wealth. Adventurers set off in search of prey. And along with them, Letizia is linked, with whom both friends are secretly in love.

Title: 78. Up the Down Staircase
description: The experiences of a young female English teacher in an inner-city New York high school.

Title: 79. Divorce American Style
description: Dick Van Dyke and Debbie Reynolds star as a suburban couple who learn that not even divorce can solve all their problems.

Title: 80. We Still Kill the Old Way
description: In Sicily, a leftist professor investigates the "honor killings" of two friends, uncovering a tangled web involving politicians, the Mafia, the Church, and the widow of one of the victims.

Title: 81. Games
description: A young couple who are into kinky "mind games" get more than they bargained for when a mysterious woman comes into their lives.

Title: 82. The Deadly Organ
description: A masked killer prowls the beaches of Argentina, injecting beautiful girls with heroin, and then using weird organ music to make them his zombie slaves.

Title: 83. Jewel Thief
description: Vinay finds his reality fractured when strangers claim he is a master thief named Amar. Caught between a jeweler's daughter and a grieving fiancee, he enters a high stakes game of impersonation to unmask his elusive double.

Title: 84. I Even Met Happy Gypsies
description: Tensions arise in a Gypsy community when a local feather seller falls in love with a much younger girl.

Title: 85. The Red and the White
description: During the Russian Civil War, the Red Army - aided by Hungarian Communists - and the White Army fight for control of the area surrounding the Volga.

Title: 86. A Colt Is My Passport
description: A hit man is hired to kill a mob boss. After the deed is done, he and his driver are wanted dead by rival gangs who joined forces.

Title: 87. Island of the Doomed
description: Baron von Weser keeps a menagerie of carnivorous plants, but takes great care of one particular specimen.

Title: 88. The Sorcerers
description: An aging hypnotist creates a device that allows the user to control the mind of another person, but his wife abuses its power by manipulating a younger man to commit evil acts.

Title: 89. Father, Behave Yourself!
description: Wealthy peasant Antonis finds out that his son spends money and time partying instead of studying. He decides to visit him and restore him to the right track, but instead he too falls into the sweet-life trap.

Title: 90. The Exchange Student
description: A strict French headmaster sends his frivolous son to England to learn English. But the student has a better idea of how to spend his summer holidays.

Title: 91. The Thief of Paris
description: In Paris around 1900, Georges Randal is brought up by his wealthy uncle, who steals his inheritance. Georges hopes to marry his cousin Charlotte, but his uncle arranges for her to marry a rich neighbour. As an act of revenge, Georges steals the fiance's family jewels, and enjoys the experience so much that he embarks upon a life-time of burglary.

Title: 92. Black Tigress
description: Lola, a saloon dancer arrives in the town of Sant'Anna with some other dancers. The town is however terrorized by El Diablo an outlaw who wants to sell the surrounding land to the railroad company. Lola helps the colonists rebel together with Rod, a youth who has fallen in love with her.

Title: 93. The Story of a Three Day Pass
description: A black American soldier is demoted for fraternizing with a white girl in France.

Title: 94. An Italian in America
description: Giuseppe, an Italian gas station attendant, is invited to the United States to reconcile with his father, who he believed had been dead for years.

Title: 95. The Unknown Man of Shandigor
description: Herbert Von Krantz does whatever it takes to keep the wrong people from finding out about his groundbreaking invention that can incapacitate nuclear bombs.

Title: 96. Grihadaha
description: Based on the novel "Grihadaha" written by Sarat Chandra Chattopadhyay.

Title: 97. Wenn Ludwig ins Manöver zieht
description: The Prussian Army comes to Bavaria for a military exercise. They show off and try to demonstrate superiority. Yet they don't stand a chance because they are not prepared to tackle Ludwig's nifty pranks.

Title: 98. A Guide for the Married Man
description: An experienced husband gives elaborate advice and tips on infidelity to his faithful friend.

Title: 99. I Am Curious (Yellow)
description: Told in a quasi-documentary style, this companion piece to I Am Curious (Blue) (1968) deals with topics such as class society, non-violent resistance, sex, relationships, and tourism to Francoist Spain.

Title: 100. Far from the Madding Crowd
description: Bathsheba Everdene, a willful, flirtatious young woman, unexpectedly inherits a large farm and is romantically pursued by three very different men.

Title: 101. La guerrillera de Villa
description: Reyes Mendoza (Carmen Sevilla) is a Spanish artist who arrives in Mexico in 1913 and finds herself involved in the Pancho Villa (Jose Elias Moreno) revolution.

Title: 102. The Incident
description: Late one night, two young toughs hold hostage the passengers in one car of a New York subway train.

Title: 103. The Happiest Millionaire
description: Clever yet hapless new butler John Lawless manages a Philadelphia household for quirky and joyful millionaire Anthony Drexel Biddle, his unflappable wife, Cordelia, and their spitfire daughter, Cordy.

Title: 104. The Way West
description: In 1843, a former U.S. Senator leads a wagon train of settlers to Oregon, but his megalomania leads to growing dissatisfaction with his leadership.

Title: 105. Clambake
description: The heir to an oil fortune trades places with a water-ski instructor at a Florida hotel to see if girls will like him for himself rather than for his father's money.

Title: 106. Un yucateco honoris causa
description: A charitable Chinese barber from Yucatán inherits a fortune of 10 million pesos.

Title: 107. God Forgives... I Don't!
description: After a train is robbed of its payroll, an insurance agent and a card-shark team up to retrieve the loot from the bandits who guard it at a secret location near the Mexican border.

Title: 108. How to Succeed in Business Without Really Trying
description: Armed with the titular manual, an ambitious window-washer seeks to climb the corporate ladder.

Title: 109. Day of Anger
description: A scruffy garbage boy becomes the pupil of a famed gunfighter, and the stage for confrontation is set when the gunman overruns the boy's town through violence and corruption.

Title: 110. I Am What I Am
description: Bernard meets Jane at a club. Finding a blackmailer's body near her, they flee from police and a dwarf's gang. Jane's father died mysteriously, linked to her stepmother's photo. They seek her brother Jerome's help.

Title: 111. She Freak
description: Claire Brennen stars as a waitress who leaves the greasy-diner business for the excitement of the carnival. She quickly discovers that she despises freaks and human oddities.

Title: 112. Will Penny
description: An old cowboy protects a woman and her son from 1880s Montana outlaws.

Title: 113. The Hellbenders
description: A former Confederate colonel leads his brutal gang across the West, carrying a fortune in stolen Union Army cash concealed within a coffin. Driven by a relentless ambition to fund a new Southern uprising, his quest spirals into tragedy.

Title: 114. The Witches
description: Five short stories loosely dealing with the roles of women in society.

Title: 115. The Ambushers
description: Secret agent Matt Helm must battle foreign spies and a rogue nation's exiled ruler in order to recover a hijacked U.S. government experimental flying saucer.

Title: 116. Carry on Doctor
description: Dr Kilmore is sacked after being discovered in a compromising position on the roof of the nurses' home. The patients are determined not to lose him, and so take on the might of the "cutting" Dr Tinkle and the overpowering Matron.

Title: 117. Easy Come, Easy Go
description: Navy frogman, Ted Jackson (Elvis Presley), balances his time between twin careers as a deep sea diver and nightclub singer. During a dive, Ted spots sunken treasure and returns with hope to retrieve it.

Title: 118. Don't Wait, Django... Shoot!
description: Django returns home to discover that his father has been killed by local bandits in a business deal gone wrong.

Title: 119. Reflections in a Golden Eye
description: Bizarre tale of sex, betrayal, and perversion at a military post. A military officer becomes obsessed with an enlisted man.

Title: 120. The Gnome-Mobile
description: In the Redwood Forests of California, a multi-millionaire lumberman and his two young grandchildren encounter two gnomes who are supposedly the last of their kind.

Title: 121. Night of the Big Heat
description: While mainland Britain shivers in deepest winter, the northern island of Fara bakes in extreme heat.

Title: 122. Asterix the Gaul
description: Asterix, the most cunning warrior of a village resisting the Roman occupation of Gaul, must save their magic potion-brewing druid when he is kidnapped by an ambitious Centurion.

Title: 123. L'occhio selvaggio
description: Documentary filmmaker travels globally, pushing crew's limits to capture raw human nature and brutality of a chaotic world, risking safety and ethics for unfiltered footage.

Title: 124. The St. Valentine's Day Massacre
description: Al Capone's Valentine's Day surprise for the rival Bugs Moran gang in 1929 Chicago.

Title: 125. Kaleidoscope
description: Young bodybuilder, a serial killer, lures women to their deaths near water. The New York police uses an undercover policewoman to try and trap him.

Title: 126. Elvira Madigan
description: The Danish tightrope dancer Elvira Madigan meets Lieutenant Sixten Sparre, a Swedish officer who is married and has two children. They both decide to run away.

Title: 127. The Reluctant Astronaut
description: A NASA janitor is sent into space.

Title: 128. The Honey Pot
description: In Venice, a millionaire hires an actor to help him prank three greedy ex-girlfriends into thinking he's dying and leaving his fortune to one of them.

Title: 129. The Torture Chamber of Dr. Sadism
description: A resurrected count who killed 12 virgins for immortality hunts the daughter of his 13th intended victim and the son of the prosecutor who condemned him, seeking vengeance.

Title: 130. The Tied-Up Balloon
description: A large balloon suddenly appears above villages and fields and grabs the attention of the peasants. They start liking the sudden guest from nowhere for the beauty of the free existence. A policeman comes and the dreams of freedom vanish.

Title: 131. The President's Analyst
description: A psychiatrist suddenly gets assigned to be the US president's shrink. Paranoid from the many spies tailing him in hope of kidnapping him, he runs away, and dozens of spies, and the FBI, CIA, and various agencies scramble to retrieve him.

Title: 132. The Big Mouth
description: On a San Diego beach, Gerald Clamson fishes out of the water a look-alike frog man who gives him a map to a stash of stolen-diamonds coveted by several crime syndicates.

Title: 133. Countdown
description: Desperate to land a man on the moon before Russia does, NASA hastily preps a would-be spaceman for a mission that would leave him alone in a lunar shelter for a year.

Title: 134. Time Warp
description: Hard-nosed new boss Stanton takes over a scientific research company upon the death of his benevolent father.

Title: 135. Dragon Inn
description: When the children of an executed General are pursued in 1457 China, some heroic martial arts swordsmen intervene.

Title: 136. Prehistoric Women
description: Jungle guide David is kidnapped by a tribe of natives who want to sacrifice him to their white rhino god. Just as he is about to be killed, however, he is thrown backwards in time to a kingdom of brunette women and their blonde slaves.

Title: 137. Hells Angels on Wheels
description: At first, gas station attendant Poet is happy when the Hell's Angels gang finally accepts him. But he's shocked when he learns just how brutal they are.

Title: 138. The Adventures of Bullwhip Griffin
description: Adventurous Bostonian Jack Flagg heads west to join the California gold rush with the hopes of restoring his family fortune, but his dedicated butler Bullwhip Griffin sets out to find Flagg and bring him back home.

Title: 139. Gallery of Horror
description: "Gallery of Horror" is a 1967 anthology horror movie with John Carradine narrating five horror tales with macabre twists.

Title: 140. Operation Kid Brother
description: The plastic surgeon brother of Britain's top spy must use his skills in hypnotism, lip-reading and archery to stop THANATOS from subjugating the world with a super-electromagnet.

Title: 141. Robbery
description: A group of British criminals plan the robbery of the Royal Mail train on the Glasgow-London route.

Title: 142. A Time for Killing
description: Confederate POWs escape a Union camp and make for the Mexico border chased by Union troops with both parties oblivious to the fact that peace was declared.

Title: 143. How I Won the War
description: An inept British World War II commander leads his troops through a series of misadventures in North Africa and Europe.

Title: 144. Mister Ten Per Cent
description: Percy Pointer's passion in life is the theatre, and all his spare time is devoted to the play he is writing.When it's finished it arrives on the desk of a London impresario, at a time when he wants to stage a flop.

Title: 145. The Bobo
description: To get his big break, a singing matador must win over the most beautiful and most elusive woman in all of Barcelona, in only three days.

Title: 146. The Tiger Makes Out
description: A mailman looks for a woman to kidnap as a personal act of insurrection.

Title: 147. Fathom
description: In Spain, an American skydiver is recruited by Western intelligence agents to recover a lost atomic bomb detonator from hostile foreign agents.

Title: 148. Ulysses
description: James Joyce's masterpiece incarnated: The story of two separated Dublin wanderers, Leopold Bloom and Stephen Dedalus, struggling to control their personal lives.

Title: 149. The Acid Eaters
description: A group of office workers go every Friday afternoon to the White Pyramid, a 50-foot tower of LSD.

Title: 150. One-Armed Swordsman
description: A noble swordsman, whose arm had been chopped off, returns to his former teacher to defend him from a villainous gang of rival swordsmen.

Title: 151. Oscar
description: Neurotic businessman must find the right man for his pregnant daughter. In fact, it is little bit complicated.

Title: 152. The 25th Hour
description: In World War II, a Romanian gentile peasant is denounced by the village gendarme and sent to a concentration camp for Jews where, due to an error, he's drafted into the S.S.

Title: 153. Woman Times Seven
description: Seven portraits of different types of women.

Title: 154. Happy End
description: A dark comedy about a murder and its consequences presented in a backwards manner, where death is actually a rebirth. The film starts with an "execution" of the main protagonist and goes back to explore his previous actions and motivations.

Title: 155. The Departure
description: Marc, a car-obsessed hair stylist, is desperate to find a Porsche to enter a professional rally. His frantic search for a vehicle leads him through a series of quirky encounters, eventually forcing him to choose between a car and a girl.

Title: 156. Tub Girls
description: "Tub Girls" features Warhol superstar Viva lying in a bathtub with different people of both sexes, including Brigid Berlin (as Brigid Polk), who appeared fully clothed in the tub.

Title: 157. The Brick Dollhouse
description: Five women explain to the police the events leading up to the murder of their roommate, an exotic dancer.

Title: 158. The Ballad of Josie
description: A widow stirs things up in a western town by raising sheep instead of cattle--and by organizing the local women to demonstrate for women's suffrage.

Title: 159. The Comedians
description: A cynical Welsh hotel owner secretly romances a diplomat's wife in Haiti, under the violent reign of the despot "Papa Doc" Duvalier.

Title: 160. Carry on Don't Lose Your Head
description: During French Revolution, English nobles Sir Rodney and Lord Darcy aid French aristocracy against Robespierre. Disguised as "Black Fingernail", Sir Rodney battles Camembert and Bidet, French secret police leaders.

Title: 161. Tobruk
description: A Canadian POW major is rescued by a special British military unit made up of Germans to help lead an attack on a major German fuel depot in Tobruk, Libya.

Title: 162. The Fox
description: Two women, Jill and Ellen, struggle with a chicken farm. Paul Grenfell returns, restores order, and proposes to Ellen. Jill's manipulations awaken Ellen's dormant homosexuality, leading them to become lovers.

Title: 163. Django Kill... If You Live, Shoot!
description: Various factions, including a half-breed bandit, a gang of homosexual cowboys, and a priest, feud over stolen gold in a surreal town.

Title: 164. Mission Stardust
description: A team of astronauts is sent to the moon to rescue an alien who is seeking help to save her dying race. They are attacked by a force of bandit robots and discover that enemy spies are out to kill the alien.

Title: 165. Common Law Cabin
description: A man runs a broken down tourist trap along the Colorado River along with his French wife and his daughter. Business is so bad that he must pay a local alcoholic to entice tourists, called "suckers", to spend some time and money there.

Title: 166. Matchless
description: A secret agent possesses a ring that makes him invisible for a short time, once every 10 hours. He is in pursuit of an evil criminal mastermind but, at the same time, must evade an enemy agent who also wants the ring.

Title: 167. Our Mother's House
description: British children hide Mother's death. Then, Father returns.

Title: 168. Diabolically Yours
description: A wealthy amnesiac begins to suspect that his devoted wife is not really his wife and that he is not the man people keep telling him he is.

Title: 169. Don't Make Waves
description: Carlo goes on a vacation to Southern California, where he quickly becomes immersed in the easygoing local culture and becomes entangled in two beach-side romances.

Title: 170. Marat/Sade
description: In an insane asylum, Marquis de Sade directs Jean Paul Marat's last days through a theater play. The actors are the patients.

Title: 171. The Mummy's Shroud
description: In 1920 an archaeological expedition discovers the tomb of an ancient Egyptian child prince. Returning home with their discovery, the expedition members soon find themselves being killed off by a mummy, which can be revived by reading the words off the prince's burial shroud.

Title: 172. King Kong Escapes
description: The evil Dr. Who captures King Kong to dig for Element X when his robot duplicate, Mechani-Kong, is unable to do the job, but Kong soon escapes and battles his doppelganger.

Title: 173. House of 1,000 Dolls
description: A couple meets their friend in Tangiers who's looking for his kidnapped girlfriend. As they help investigate, dark forces surrounding a nightclub act are revealed to be part of a sinister human trafficking operation.

Title: 174. Shanty Tramp
description: A sleazy evangelist makes a play for a small town's local shanty tramp, but is shocked to learn that she prefers a local young Black man over him. Furious, he stirs the town up against the couple.

Title: 175. Waterhole #3
description: Professional gambler Lewton Cole kills a Confederate soldier, then finds a map pinpointing the desert location where stolen Army gold bullion is buried. Cole plans to retrieve it, but other parties are searching for it, too.

Title: 176. The Outsiders
description: A rich, aristocratic engaged couple (Julissa, Enrique Alvarez Felix) abandons a dinner party to enjoy a night on the town with an urban gang known as Los Caifanes.

Title: 177. Carry on Follow That Camel
description: In 1906, a young English gentleman is falsely accused of cheating at a game of cricket, so he travels to North Africa to join the French Foreign Legion, and becomes involved in all types of mischief with other soldiers and an Arab sheikh.

Title: 178. Those Fantastic Flying Fools
description: In Victorian England, an American showman uses a wealthy Frenchman's finances to build a German explosives expert's giant cannon designed to fire a people-filled projectile to the Moon, but spies and saboteurs endanger the project.

Title: 179. The Fastest Guitar Alive
description: Near the ending days of the Civil War, a group of Confederacy spies traveling under guises of musicians is tasked to steal a shipment of gold. If anything goes wrong, one spy (Roy Orbison) has a bullet-shooting guitar handy.

Title: 180. Hurry Sundown
description: Drama of a ruthless Southern opportunist who tries to buy his cousin's land, and when thwarted, brings several tragedies to the lives of his loved ones.

Title: 181. Japanese Erotica: Five Films on Love and Sex from the Japanese Underground of the Experimental Cinema
description: A program of five films on love and sex from the Japanese underground of the experimental cinema, assembled by avant-garde cineaste Takahiko Iimura, and shown at the American Cinematheque from January 19 to 25, 1967.

Title: 182. Fantomas vs. Scotland Yard
description: Famous but unlucky pursuers of Fantomas from France go to weird Scotland for a final attempt to bring the impudent criminal to justice.

Title: 183. The Terrornauts
description: A group of scientists are kidnapped and taken into outer space aboard a saucer.

Title: 184. The Million Eyes of Sumuru
description: Sumuru, a megalomaniacal femme fatale, makes a bid for world domination by eliminating male leaders and replacing them with her sexy female agents.

Title: 185. Banning
description: A hustling golf pro takes a golf instructor job at an exclusive country club where the owner and his son-in-law are fleecing the wealthy guests by using various schemes.

Title: 186. Hotel
description: A historical New Orleans hotel struggles to financially survive while the dramas of its various guests unfold.

Title: 187. The Happening
description: Young drifters kidnap rich businessman Roc Delmonico for kicks and demand $200K for his release. But none of Roc's relatives or Mafia associates want to part with the money. So Roc switches allegiances and plots revenge.

Title: 188. Caprice
description: An industrial designer causes chaos when she sells a secret cosmetics formula to a rival company.

Title: 189. Catalina Caper
description: Swingin' teens take time out from having fun in the sun to try to foil a group of crooks searching for a stolen scroll.

Title: 190. Doctor Faustus
description: A man sells his soul to the devil in order to have the woman he loves.

Title: 191. Beast of Morocco
description: A handsome tourist travelling through the desert comes upon a lavish Moorish castle wherein he is entertained by a mysterious wealthy woman.

Title: 192. Double Trouble
description: When singer Guy Lambert goes on tour in Europe, he is pursued by two beautiful women, bumbling jewel thieves, and a mysterious killer.

Title: 193. Poor Cow
description: A young woman lives a life full of bad choices. At a young age she has a baby by an abusive thief who quickly lands in prison. When her son goes missing, she gets to grips with what is most important to her.

Title: 194. Anna Karenina
description: Anna Karenina is a young wife of an older husband. She has an affair with the handsome Count Vronsky. By following her desires Anna complicates her life.

Title: 195. Gamera vs. Gyaos
description: Volcanic activity unleashes a bloodthirsty monster called Gyaos that Gamera must confront.

Title: 196. The Oldest Profession
description: A collection of sketches that tells the story of prostitution through the ages.

Title: 197. More Than a Miracle
description: In 17th-century Italy, a Spanish prince searching for a bride falls in love with a beautiful local peasant girl.

Title: 198. Counterpoint
description: A famous orchestra conductor is captured by the Germans in WW2, and is forced to perform at private concerts for the Nazi generals.

Title: 199. Good Times
description: Sonny and Cher spoof many Hollywood classic movie scenes.

Title: 200. The Whisperers
description: A lonely elderly Englishwoman talks to herself and hears voices talking about her.

Title: 201. Hugo and Josephine
description: Josefin is a six-year-old girl who lives isolated in the countryside, where her father is a priest. She has no friends until she meets Hugo. He is a carefree boy who rather walk in the forest than go to school. Together with the gardener they make up fun things to do.

Title: 202. Chuka
description: While Indians besiege a U.S. Army fort in 1876, residents of the fort, a gunfighter, a stagecoach driver, two Mexican women, and a motley company of soldiers, try to come to terms with their pasts.

Title: 203. Novios 68
description: Emilio is a gigolo who has hidden relationships with 3 girlfriends at once: Gela, Teresa, pharmacist, and Susana, flight attendant. Marcelino is a percussionist in an orchestra and boyfriend of Conchita, who works in a florist shop. Julia is Antonio's office worker and girlfriend, a lazy man without trade or benefit. Pepe is a plumber and boyfriend of Gela's sister. Federico is a manufacturer of blinds. He accidentally runs over Julia, so they end up falling in love. Lucia is a maid and girlfriend of Saturnino, a pawn of works that has just finished military service. The vicissitudes occurred in the courtships of these people in the Spain of 1968 are narrated in a comedy tone.

Title: 204. The Jackals
description: Bad bank robber falls in love with granddaughter of miner he and his men planned to rob of gold, has change of heart.

Title: 205. Tätowierung
description: Capturing the zeitgeist of discontent and rebellion, the movie anticipates the protests of 1968.

Title: 206. P.J.
description: A down-on-his-luck New York private eye takes a bodyguard job for the death-threatened mistress of a shady millionaire and gets involved in conspiracy and murder.

Title: 207. Peppermint Frappé
description: Julian, content, meets friend Pablo's fiancée Elena. Obsessed with free-spirited Elena who rejects him. Pursues meek nurse Ana, tries molding her like Elena.

Title: 208. The Touch of Her Flesh
description: A distraught weapons dealer is involved in an automobile accident after catching his stripper wife in bed with another man. Upon recovering, he goes on a killing spree, bumping off exotic dancers and hookers while plotting revenge.

Title: 209. Spring Night, Summer Night
description: Jessica, the eldest daughter of a coal miner-turned-farmer, has a fling with her half-brother Carl, which complicates things more when she becomes pregnant.

Title: 210. Custer of the West
description: George Armstrong Custer's love of the heroic traditions of the Calvary and his distaste with the coming of industrialization leads him to his destiny at the Little Big Horn.

Title: 211. Rough Night in Jericho
description: A former deputy and a strong-willed widow are determined to stop a ruthless town boss.

Title: 212. The Nude Restaurant
description: At a New York City restaurant, the patrons are men, nude but for a G-string, waited on by one woman, also clad in a G-string (played by Viva) and a G-bestringed (bestrung?) waiter. Some of the "nude" patrons leave the establishment, their places taken by new customers, also nearly in the buff. There are numerous in-camera jump cuts (known as 'strobe cuts') and the camera weaves around a bit. The waiter and waitress move from table to table, talking to the customers. Taylor Mead sits smirking at the fountain, where eventually he partakes in a long conversation with Viva about her Catholic childhood. Viva, the waitress if not the actual person, seemingly is obsessed with the subject of lascivious priests. There is more strobe cutting and at one point, Viva turns to the camera and asks that it be turned off. The camera is turned off and, after an interlude, is turned back on again, after which Viva continues with her monologue. More patrons arrive while others go, perhaps thinking -- if not speaking -- of Michelangelo.

Title: 213. Rosie!
description: A widowed millionaire announces that she intends to buy a closed theater, the location where her late husband proposed, much to the dismay of her cold-hearted daughters who try to commit her to an insane asylum.

Title: 214. Night Fright
description: A government space experiment into the effects of cosmic rays on animal life goes horribly wrong, creating a mutant monster that terrorizes a rural community.

Title: 215. Farz
description: Gopal, a secret agent, investigates the death of his colleague who possessed evidence against a known terrorist. Gopal and Kamla embark on a journey to find the traitor.

Title: 216. Inflatable Sex Doll of the Wastelands
description: A private detective is hired to find a woman who has apparently been murdered in a snuff film. It turns out the woman's not dead, but very much alive, and he gets sucked into a torrid affair with her that leaves him questioning his sense of reality.

Title: 217. Charlie, the Lonesome Cougar
description: When a cougar raised by a group of loggers in the Pacific Northwest reverts to its natural instincts, the consequence could threaten its life.

Title: 218. S.O.S. Operation Bikini
description: A secret agent infiltrates S.O.S., a crime ring masquerading as a model agency. When she's compromised after sending a coded message, agents Alex Dinamo and Adriana must help rescue her.

Title: 219. This Night I'll Possess Your Corpse
description: After the events of the previous film, Coffin Joe continues to seek a maiden to give him a son. With the help of servant Bruno, he kidnaps six girls from a village. Which one of them will pass his trials of fear?

Title: 220. A Minute to Pray, a Second to Die
description: When the Governor of New Mexico offers amnesty to all outlaws, gunfighter Clay McCord triggers a violent confrontation between himself, the local marshal, and other bandits.

Title: 221. Eleven Samurai
description: The lord of the Oshi fief is killed by his trespassing neighbor, Nariatsu. But when the Oshi clan is blamed for the incident, eleven of their best warriors decide to trade their lives for justice.

Title: 222. 40 Guns to Apache Pass
description: The Apaches are on the warpath and the Army must defeat them. Murphy's mission is to get a shipment of rifles, but they're stolen by greedy white traders with the help of mutinous soldiers.

Title: 223. Two Weeks in September
description: Story of a woman torn between her love for two different men.

Title: 224. Argoman the Fantastic Superman
description: Argoman is practically invincible with powers beyond the scope of mortal man but loses his power once he engages sexual intercourse with a woman. Just when he lost his powers, the amazon queen Jenabell tries to conquer the world.

Title: 225. I'll Never Forget What's'isname
description: The professional and romantic misadventures of an advertising executive in 1960s swinging London.

Title: 226. Welcome to Hard Times
description: A sociopathic stranger all but destroys a small hardscrabble town but the 'mayor' convinces its survivors to stay and rebuild.

Title: 227. Monkeys, Go Home!
description: A young American inherits an olive farm in France and decides to use four chimpanzees to harvest the fruit when he finds the price of the local labor to be too costly.

Title: 228. Grand Slam
description: To pull off a daring diamond heist in Rio during Carnival, a retired schoolteacher hires four professionals who must contend with a revolutionary alarm system and a taciturn secretary.

Title: 229. Half a Sixpence
description: Arthur Kipps, an orphan apprenticed to a tyrannical owner of a mercantile, has a sudden abrupt change of life when his wealthy grandfather dies and leaves him a pile of money.

Title: 230. Enter Laughing
description: A young would-be actor seeks his first break.

Title: 231. Su excelencia
description: Lopez, treated derisively by all as Lopitos, is a humble but loyal citizen of Los Cocos Republic who works as an assistant at the chancellery, helping to process visas. Through a sudden series of events, namely the Los Cocos Ambassador's fear of the number 13, a strict protocol, three military coups, and a revolution, all successful in the same day, with many changes in governments, and ambassadors, Lopitos becomes the ambassador--just when a powerful international struggle is taking place and the Red and Green factions are vying to attract all the yet-undecided votes among the nations of the world, to convene soon in an international conference to decide who will govern the world. All of the nations have either lined up behind the "Green" banner, led by the money-oriented Dolaronia, or the "Red" ideology, whose figurehead is the prime minister of socialist Pepeslavia; except, of course, the recently appointed civil government of Los Cocos. With the votes divided 50-50 between the Red and Green factions, diplomacy, bribery, and personal corruption fall heavily on the shoulders of His Excellency Lopitos to gain his vote. His speech will be the last at the large assembly, after long tirades from adepts of both factions, and it is a speech to end all speeches.

Title: 232. Devil's Angels
description: An exiled band of Hell's Angels strike a bargain with the Sheriff of a local town, let them stay and the town is safe. But a local girl strays into their lair and sparks off a full scale Angel war.

Title: 233. Chingachgook: The Great Serpent
description: Chingachgook is about to marry the daughter of the Delaware chief, when the Hurons kidnap her. Chingachgook and his friend Deerslayer try to rescue her though white scalp hunters interfere until the tribes unite against the palefaces.

Title: 234. Wavelength
description: Claimed by some to be one of the most unconventional and experimental films ever made, Wavelength is a structural film of a 45-minute long zoom in on a window over a period of a week. Very unconventional and experimental, indeed.

Title: 235. The Last Challenge
description: A deadly gunslinger travels to a town to shoot it out with a famed gunslinger turned lawman in a small town.

Title: 236. Muhair
description: Eva is a prostitute who earns her living at the town cabaret. On Sundays, however, she abandons herself in the arms and passion of José in an oasis of sexual pleasure. The problem arises when Josep's son appears who also desires her.

Title: 237. Gungala, the Virgin of the Jungle
description: Two unscrupulous explorers rob a sacred diamond from the Basoko tribe of leopard-men. Their white queen, Gungala, and her pet, a black panther, lead the revenge to impose the justice of the jungle.

Title: 238. Love Affair, or The Case of the Missing Switchboard Operator
description: A young female starts a love relationship with a serious young man. However, while he is away on business, she gets lonely and succumbs to her colleague's desires.

Title: 239. The Naked Runner
description: During the Cold War, an American industrial-designer living in London is used by the MI-6 as an unwilling pawn in the spy game during a trip to a trade show in East Germany.

Title: 240. The Plank
description: The slapstick perilous misadventures of two clumsy construction builders who require a wooden floorboard.

Title: 241. Yongary, Monster from the Deep
description: Earthquakes in central Korea turn out to be the work of Yongary, a prehistoric gasoline-eating reptile that soon goes on a rampage through Seoul.

Title: 242. Taqdeer
description: For the well-being of her children, a destitute widow is forced to marry a man she dislikes.

Title: 243. Helga
description: Sexually inexperienced and uneducated, Helga gets married. A gynecologist explains to her about sexual intercourse and birth control. Soon pregnant, she attends a course for expectant mothers, where she is given detailed information.

Title: 244. Privilege
description: Britain's biggest pop singer, Steven Shorter (Paul Jones), receives unwavering adulation and possesses total control over his rabid fans, which includes nearly the entire population. Yet Shorter is not an autonomous performer -- he is little more than a puppet for the government, promoting whatever agenda they see fit. When a beautiful artist, Vanessa Ritchie (Jean Shrimpton), is commissioned to paint his portrait, she pushes Shorter to question his obedience to his manipulative handlers.

Title: 245. Martha
description: S/S Martha is from 1927 and no maintenance's been done since. Forgotten by HQ in CPH, the Danish crew has a good, stressless time. They celebrate a virgin crew member's 17th birthday buying him a woman. Suddenly, Martha's noticed by HQ.

Title: 246. It!
description: A museum's storehouse burns, leaving just one statue. After director Grove is found dead, assistant Pimm learns the statue was made by Rabbi Loew and is indestructible. Pimm plans to use this information.

Title: 247. Shock Troops
description: A French resistance group liberates some prisoners from the German. Could one of the prisoners be a spy?

Title: 248. Hamraaz
description: A celebrated stage performer discovers his wife's sudden withdrawal masks a labyrinth of secret identities. When she is found dead, he becomes the prime suspect in a web involving a former marriage, a hidden child, and a mystery man.

Title: 249. The X from Outer Space
description: When a crew of scientists returns from Mars with a sample of the space spores that contaminated their ship, the sample escapes and grows into an enormous, rampaging beaked beast.

Title: 250. Gunn
description: When crime boss Scarlotti is murdered, PI Peter Gunn is distraught and angry. Scarlotti saved his life once. Nick Fusco, the new kingpin, is the prime suspect for the murder but it's going to be a struggle for Gunn to investigate him.

Title: 251. Blast-Off Girls
description: A sleazy record promoter tries to make it big with a local Chicago garage band--and plans to make them famous while keeping the profits for himself.

Title: 252. Violated Angels
description: A young man breaks into a nurse's rooming house and one-by-one kills off nurses.

Title: 253. She-Man: A Story of Fixation
description: A soldier is forced to take estrogen and wear lingerie when he's blackmailed by a violent transvestite.

Title: 254. Herostratus
description: When young poet Max (Michael Gothard) hires a marketing company to turn his suicide-by-jumping into a mass-media spectacle, he finds that his subversive intentions are quickly diluted into a reactionary gesture, and his motivations are revealed as a desperate attempt to seek attention through celebrity.

Title: 255. Ram Aur Shyam
description: After being abused by his oppressive brother-in-law, a man flees home and ends up in a small village where he is mistaken for another person. He must accept his new name or face an exorcism.

Title: 256. Man, Pride & Vengeance
description: A stalwart Spanish soldier turns to a life of crime to prove his love for a mysterious and promiscuous gypsy woman.

Title: 257. Something Weird
description: An accident victim makes a deal with a particularly hideous witch, in which he receives extraordinary ESP powers, which he uses to help the police solve crimes.

Title: 258. A Degree of Murder
description: After accidentally shooting dead her ex-lover during a fight, Marie enlists the help of a stranger, Gunther, and his friend, Fritz, to dispose of the body while becoming intimate with both men.

Title: 259. Live for Life
description: The bitter relationships between a journalist and his women.

Title: 260. The Gruesome Twosome
description: A demented elderly woman has her mentally-retarded son kill and scalp various young women to use their hair for her wig shop while a persistent coed tries to link various killings on a local Florida college campus to them.

Title: 261. The Tale of Tsar Saltan
description: The envious sisters of the young queen stand in the way of her happiness. A fairy tale based on Alexander Pushkin novel.

Title: 262. Noz
description: A popular folk singer is found murdered and two police detectives are investigating his past in order to catch the killer.

Title: 263. Il padre di famiglia
description: Two architects meet some time after World War II and get married. Though they are deeply in love, they come from different backgrounds and do not share the same outlooks on life. Soon she becomes fascinated with his progressive socialist ideals.

Title: 264. The Rover
description: A former counter-revolutionary pirate befriends a mentally ill young woman and this in turn leads to tragedy after she falls in love with a French naval officer.

Title: 265. Oi voskoi
description: Thanos, a poor shepherd who has returned to Greece after spending time in Germany as an immigrant worker, puts into motion the mechanism of fate.

Title: 266. Blood of the Virgins
description: Ofelia's wedding day is approaching and she is to be married to Eduardo. She has some pre-wedding jitters during a meeting with her lover Gustavo but decides to tie the knot anyways. On her wedding night, Gustavo shows up in their room, murders Eduardo, and proceeds to turn Ofelia into a vampire so that they can be together forever. In the present day 1960's, a group of young men and women take shelter in an abandoned lodge after their van breaks down. Soon, Ofelia appears and seduces one of the guys. Meanwhile, the girls of the group wind up missing. It is up to the other guys to figure out what is happening and Ofelia must make a decision as to how much longer she can continue with her cursed life.

Title: 267. Our Folks
description: Two peasant families, forced from their lands by war, find themselves settled by chance on neighboring farms, reigniting old feuds.

Title: 268. Luv
description: Milt, who's having difficulties with his wife, runs into his friend Harry, who's about to kill himself. Milt asks Harry to stay with his wife Ellen while he goes off with his girlfriend. Harry and Ellen hit it off immediately, but Milton strikes out.

Title: 269. Jennie: Wife/Child
description: The seeds of revenge become planted in an old farmer's mind after he finds out that his sexy young child bride is getting way too cozy with the hired help on his farm.

Title: 270. The Naked Witch
description: Beth is a young woman who must struggle with being shunned by society for her past legacy, as well as developing a romance with a local fisherman, and then seeks protection by hiding out with a simple-minded hunchback.

Title: 271. Who's Minding the Mint?
description: A mint worker accidentally destroys some money and decides to break in and reprint it, but finds he has some unwanted partners.

Title: 272. It's a Bikini World
description: Male chauvinist Mike attempts to get an intelligent burgeoning feminist Delilah into his harem. When she resists, Mike then poses as his brother Herbert, but in the process falls in love with Delilah.

Title: 273. The Tiger and the Pussycat
description: A middle-aged businessman finds himself in thirst for romance adventure, and it seems that a proper partner is not far away.

Title: 274. Las que tienen que servir
description: In the sixties, U.S.A.F and Spanish Air Forces share the military base at "Torrejon de Ardoz", Spain. An american aviator and his wife take a couple of spanish maids in order to serve in their house. Both maids are engaged with local men, but two american boys appear in action and the things become quite complicated. This story is adapted from a theater comedy of that time.

Title: 275. The Day the Fish Came Out
description: A plane carrying a weapon more dangerous than a nuclear weapon goes down near Greece. To prevent panic, the officials go in dressed as tourists (who are dressed so casually, that the pilots assume that they are all gay). The pilots are not to make themselves known and can't contact the rescue team. The secrecy causes a comedy of errors including the desolate Greek Isle deciding that since tourists have now arrived, they have to become touristy.

Title: 276. Tarzan and the Great River
description: In Brazil, Dr. Ann Philips tries to inoculate the superstitious natives against an epidemic. The murderous Jaguar Men oppose the intrusion. The natives take heart when the riverboat captain's helper Pepe volunteers for the first shot.

Title: 277. Any Gun Can Play
description: A gang robs a gold shipment from a train. A so called bounty hunter is sent to track down the robbers and decides to let them lead him to the gold.

Title: 278. Good Morning... and Goodbye!
description: A man tries to end his wife's infidelities after an ancient witch reawakens his virility.

Title: 279. Hot Thrills and Warm Chills
description: Three women who haven't seen each other for years meet at a motel to talk about what they've done since they were together, and also to plan a heist of the King of Sex's crown during the upcoming Mardi Gras carnival. They pull the heist and are pursued by relentless detectives, and they must use their feminine charms to escape incarceration.

Title: 280. The Commissar
description: Klavdia Vavilova, a Red Army cavalry commissar, is waylaid by an unexpected pregnancy. She stays with a Jewish family to give birth and is softened somewhat by the experience of family life.

Title: 281. The Spirit Is Willing
description: Hapless Benjamin Powell, his loving wife Kate, and their teenage son Steven rent a haunted seaside house in New England for their summer vacation, which quickly turns into a ghost-hunt.

Title: 282. The Degenerates
description: In a post-nuclear holocaust world, a three nomadic men are accosted by a group of five murderous women living in a secluded farmhouse.

Title: 283. The Champagne Murders
description: A champagne tycoon's (Furneaux) partner (Ronet) suspects his partner's gigolo husband (Perkins) of murders he's been framed for.

Title: 284. Portrait of Jason
description: Black gay prostitute Jason Holliday is rigorously interviewed on his story and character, revealing nuanced truths about life and art.

Title: 285. Oh Dad, Poor Dad, Mamma's Hung You in the Closet and I'm Feelin' So Sad
description: Domineering Madame Rosepettle and her sheltered wimpy man-child son Jonathan fly face first into love, murder, and the meaning of family during this black comedy based on Arthur Kopit's Broadway play.

Title: 286. Brief Encounters
description: A maid works for the estranged wife of a geologist who once visited her village and whom she loves.

Title: 287. Nel sole
description: Carlo, a poor youth who works to pay for his studies, and is in love with Lorena, a rich girl. He pretends to be a tycoon with the help of two friends of his: a butler and a chauffeur.

Title: 288. Ghosts, Italian Style
description: Married couple Pasquale and Maria live rent-free in a supposedly haunted palace. When Pasquale discovers food in the cupboard, he believes ghosts left it, but it's actually from Maria's wealthy lover who gives her gifts.

Title: 289. Bomb at 10:10
description: An American P.O.W. works with Yugoslav partisans to assassinate an SS colonel and concentration camp commandant.

Title: 290. Eight on the Lam
description: A bank teller is suspected of embezzlement and goes on the run with his seven children.

Title: 291. The Double Man
description: In a complex piece of espionage the Russian secret service attempts to kidnap a high ranking officer in the CIA and replace him with a double of its own.

Title: 292. Untamable Angelique
description: Angélique sets sail for the Mediterranean in the hope of uncovering the truth about the ultimate fate of her husband and true love, Count Jeoffrey.

Title: 293. I a Man
description: About a male hustler who talks with and sleeps with a series of women.

Title: 294. Die Heiden von Kummerow und ihre lustigen Streiche
description: Children reviving an old heathen ritual by standing in the frigid waters of the Baltic Sea; the one standing in the longest shall be referred to as the king of Kummerow.

Title: 295. Sing a Song of Sex
description: Four high school students preparing for their university entrance exam fantasize about a classmate, and meet up with their inebriated teacher, while singing bawdy drinking songs.

Title: 296. The Penthouse
description: Three thugs--Tom, Dick, and Harry (a woman)--break into the penthouse apartment of an adulterous couple and proceed to terrorize them, until the unexpected happens.

Title: 297. Danger!! Death Ray
description: Secret Agent Bart Fargo chases the kidnappers of the inventor of a death ray.

Title: 298. Danger Route
description: During the Cold War, a British secret agent is ordered to kill a Soviet-bloc defector held by the CIA in England but this straightforward mission turns into a convoluted plot involving double-agents.

Title: 299. David Holzman's Diary
description: A young filmmaker decides to make a movie of his life.

Title: 300. Ukradená vzducholod
description: Five young boys take off in a lighter-than-air machine from the Centenary Exposition in Prague.

Title: 301. The White Bus
description: A young woman witnesses bizarre occurrences during a bus trip.

Title: 302. A Taste of Blood
description: A businessman turns into a vampire after drinking brandy laced with vampire blood and sets out on an odyssey of killing the descendent's of Dracula's executioners.

Title: 303. A Challenge for Robin Hood
description: Robin, a young Norman nobleman, is falsely accused by his cousin of murdering another cousin. His accuser is actually in league with the corrupt Sheriff of Nottingham to seize control of the family lands, which Robin would inherit. Forced to flee into nearby Sherwood Forest, Robin begins to gather a band of rebels to fight against his scheming cousin and the evil sheriff.

Title: 304. A Matter of Innocence
description: Miss Polly decides to spend a few months with her wealthy spinster aunt as a travelling companion. While in India, her aunt's demise leaves her alone to pursue her freedom and explore an arm's-length romance with a local youth. This film is a tender, fun-loving, and poetic representation of that transition from youth to young womanhood.

Title: 305. Electra One
description: A criminal organization led by a man named Elektra has found a serum capable of unleashing aggressive to anyone who furnishes. Aware of the news, the Soviet and American governments decide to join forces to stop the dangerous threat.

Title: 306. The Stranger Returns
description: A cynical gunfighter, aided by an elderly prophet, becomes involved in a feud with a bandit gang trying to obtain a stagecoach made of solid gold.

Title: 307. Doctor, You've Got to Be Kidding!
description: Heather is the lead singer for a band that is on its way to fame and fortune. Things get complicated when she becomes pregnant and has three men willing to be both husband and father. But her boss isn't one of them.

Title: 308. Lust Weekend
description: David and Jane, a happily married couple, are abducted by a secret sex cult led by Persephone who subjects them to the most horrific sexual torture they have ever imagined.

Title: 309. The Perils of Pauline
description: Pauline becomes involved in a series of adventures around the world and is aided by her ever present friend George. The adventures are unrelated as the film was made up from television episodes.

Title: 310. The Long Duel
description: To protest against British oppression and tyranny a tribal leader becomes a bandit.

Title: 311. Requiescant
description: A preacher's adopted son comes upon a village that is under the thumb of a deranged ex-Confederate officer who, among other things, is stealing land from the locals with phony land grants.

Title: 312. The Viking Queen
description: Saline inherits the kingdom of England on the eve of the signing of the treaty sharing power with the Roman Empire. However, revolt was brewing, threatening the fragile peace.

Title: 313. The Vengeance of Fu Manchu
description: Fu Manchu replaces his arch-nemesis Nayland Smith with a hypnotized, murderous doppelgänger as part of a plan to become leader of the world's criminals.

Title: 314. Fiend with the Electronic Brain
description: A mad scientist implants an electronic device into the brain of an injured soldier, which turns him into a psychotic killer.

Title: 315. A Taste of Flesh
description: Two professional assassins take over the home of two women (who happen to be lesbians) and their "houseguest" in order to assassinate a visiting foreign dignitary.

Title: 316. An Idiot in Paris
description: Goubi, the simpleton of his village in the French Department Allier, has but one wish: to see Paris. One day, the truckers Grafouillère deposit a drunk Goubi in the biggest market of Paris (the "Halles"). The poor man is completely lost, but the meat merchant Dessertine takes him under his wings when he hears that Goubi was likewise 'raised by the State'...

Title: 317. Pedro Paramo
description: Highly symbolic Mexican drama: Son searches for father during Mexican Revolution chaos. Archetypal figures appear amid violence. Contrasts son's quest with father's earthy lifestyle.

Title: 318. Wanted
description: A local sheriff is unjustly accused of murder in a small town and forced to flee. He gets rid of his enemies one by one and tries to prove his innocence.

Title: 319. Anyone Can Play
description: In this delightful romantic comedy, four beautiful women attempt to deal with their sexual frustrations in fashionable Rome society.

Title: 320. Festival
description: This documentary captures performances, interviews, and conversations from the 1963-1966 Newport Folk Festivals.

Title: 321. Beach Red
description: As a US marine unit fight against the defenders of a Japanese held island, both sides are haunted by their own thoughts and memories.

Title: 322. Gentle Giant
description: A young boy befriends an orphaned cub and raises him to adult-bearhood. This fine family feature. based on Walt Morey's novel "Gentle Ben," was the basis for the "Gentle Ben" television series.

Title: 323. Stimulantia
description: A Swedish film in eight episodes by directors Ingmar Bergman, Vilgot Sjöman, Lars Görling, Hans Alfredson, Tage Danielsson, Hans Abramson, Jörn Donner, Arne Arnbom, Gustaf Molander.

Title: 324. An Evening in Paris
description: After being left brokenhearted several times, wealthy, beautiful Deepa travels to City of Love Paris to live in her palatial house and meets Shyam (Sam), an Indian who is fascinated by her beauty. She tries to ignore him and finally pretends to be the housemaid. Shekar is a spoiled brat of her secretary Damodar, known for his bad habits of gambling and womanizing; he is in debt to local don Jack and tries to woo Deepa and convince her to marry him. Sam always gets in Shekar's way and spoils his plans; after a few misunderstandings, Deepa and Sam fall in love. Jack warns Shekar to pay his debts soon or face the brunt but Shekar's plans go for naught when he discovers that Deepa loves Sam. To Jack's surprise, Deepa is a lookalike of Suzy, a cabaret dancer in his club. When Shekar meets Suzy, he plots with her to replace Suzy with Deepa to clear his debts. But on the very first instance Sam gets suspicious that she is not the real Deepa.

Title: 325. Arabella
description: Virna Lisi is at her peak using her womanly wiles to seduce Terry-Thomas (in multiple roles) to aid her debt-ridden grandmother, Dame Margaret Rutherford.

Title: 326. Noche de vino tinto
description: A boy and a girl, both depressed, meet in a bar. Although they do not know each other, they start a tour at night through the bars in the city. As the night progresses, both are getting to know better.

Title: 327. Les risques du métier
description: A respected teacher's life crumbles when a student accuses him of attempted rape. Despite his spotless reputation and happy marriage to a fellow teacher, the student's family files charges against him.

Title: 328. Japan's Longest Day
description: A dramatization of the 24-hour period in which the Japanese government was deadlocked over the decision to accept or reject the Allies' demand for an unconditional surrender following the bombings of Hiroshima and Nagasaki.

Title: 329. The Ride to Hangman's Tree
description: Three young outlaws try to stay together and keep one step ahead of the law.

Title: 330. Hell on Wheels
description: Two brothers, one a popular race car driver that all the women love and the other a brilliant mechanic who makes the winning possible, become enemies when one messes with the other's girlfriend.

Title: 331. Five Golden Dragons
description: A naive young American playboy in Hong Kong finds himself caught up in the middle of an international crime.

Originally a twenty five hour film made up of shorter film segments. It consists of 83 reels each lasting approximately 33 minutes. A short story odyssey of film designed to be shown with two projectors playing simultaneously.

Title: 333. Bike Boy
description: Joe Spencer, a member of a motorcycle gang, is taking a shower. After his bout with personal hygiene, Joe encounters Andy Warhol's "superstars," who engage him in conversation. The superstars crack jokes he doesn't understand and continually correct his poor pronunciation in an attempt to deflate his machismo. In response to these provocations, Joe becomes more obscene and more boasting, but ultimately, he cannot compete with the put-downs that are part of the put-on performances of the Warhol superstars, who prevail over him in the end.

Title: 334. Bewitched Love
description: A violent man and a passionate man are dueling for the heart of the pretty young country girl.

Title: 335. Carmen, Baby
description: A sexy temptress no man can resist and a local police officer who falls hard for her become embroiled in a complicated intrigue of passion and jealousy in Radley Metzger's boldly original erotic update of the opera Carmen.

Title: 336. The Harem
description: A seductive woman pushes three men to the limits toying with their sexual desires and male pride.

Title: 337. The Boy and the Wind
description: Young engineer on holiday gets involved with a boy having a strange relationship with the wind. Their close friendship arouses suspicion in the small town. When the boy disappears, the engineer is accused of murdering him. But the wind...

Title: 338. Il marchio di Kriminal
description: Whereas the first film concerned a string of diamond robberies , this involves the search for a couple of missing paintings by world-renowned artists - the map of the location in question is hidden inside four identical statues of a Buddha.

Title: 339. The Jokers
description: Michael Tremayne (Michael Crawford) and David Tremayne (Oliver Reed) decide to steal the Crown Jewels from the Tower of London, not for criminal purposes, but to make themselves famous.

Title: 340. Two Crosses at Danger Pass
description: Judy and Alex are the only two survivors of a punishment mission ordered by the rich and ruthless Moran... The girl becomes his maid and the boy is adopted by a Quaker family. Alex, in spite of the pardon philosophy taught to him, he is planning to revenge.

Title: 341. Susanne, die Wirtin von der Lahn
description: In the former Kingdom of Westphalia, where Napoleon's brother Jeröme rules, there is an old inn not far from the university town of Giessen an der Lahn that is owned by the beautiful, red-haired Suzanne.

Title: 342. The Face of Medusa
description: On a deserted Greek island a number of men are leaded by an attractive female who, like a medusa or spider, devours any male without inhibition.

Title: 343. Smashing Time
description: Two young women arrive in London to make it big in show business, and become corrupted by money and fame in the process.

Title: 344. Body of the Prey
description: A NASA scientist turns a Venus Flytrap into a monstrous humanoid while on vacation in Japan.

Title: 345. Segretissimo
description: A man escapes from a Russian prison and then from a United States embassy, taking with him some very important top secret information from both sides.

Title: 346. Zatoichi Challenged
description: After an artist is threatened by the yakuza into creating valuable but highly illegal pornography, the law aims to execute him. Zatoichi, having been honor bound to protect the man and his family, must now run against the law.

Title: 347. Fort Utah
description: An ex-gunfighter goes up against a man who is trying to stir up trouble with the Indians to enrich himself.

Title: 348. Django Kills Softly
description: Thompson's gang assaults a caravan; Bill, an involuntary witness, manages to escape and save Linda's life. The two take refuge in the neighboring village, that is, where the bandits are.

Title: 349. Desert Commandos
description: German commandos are dropped behind enemy lines in the Sahara Desert and tasked with getting to Casablanca to assassinate Allied leaders.

Title: 350. Crazy Westerners
description: Little Rita is a female gunslinger who travels to the Far West chasing outlaws. She takes gold from them and hides it in a cave which she plans to blow up one day and get rid of the root of all evil: money.

Title: 351. Ultraman
description: A feature-length compilation of episodes of the famous Japanese sci-fi TV series about a futuristic policeman who secretly transforms into a giant extraterrestrial savior.

Title: 352. The Elusive Avengers
description: Teenagers take revenge on cruel chieftains during the civil war. Soviet blockbuster in the best traditions of the western

Title: 353. $10,000 Blood Money
description: Hired by a Mexican landowner to rescue his daughter from a bandit, a bounty hunter instead joins the crook on a heist to obtain a higher pay-out, leading to a tragic double-cross.

Title: 354. The Destructors
description: Foreign agents are after a substance called "laser rubies" that can power a killer laser beam. Government agents are dispatched to protect the rubies and eliminate the foreign agents.

Title: 355. Upkar
description: Cult classic highlighting the contrast between Indian and Western values in the newly independent state.

Title: 356. Tom and Jerry the Chuck Jones Collection
357. The Cape Town Affair
description: South African secret agents attempt to save confidential microfilm before it falls into the hands of Communists.

Title: 358. Three Bites of the Apple
description: A woman (Sylva Koscina) offers to help a British tour guide (David McCallum) avoid paying taxes on his Italian casino winnings.

Title: 359. Scattered Clouds
description: A man falls in love with the widow of a man he killed in a car accident. Eventually she falls in love with him in return.

Title: 360. Santo vs. the Martian Invasion
description: The masked wrestler battles Martians intent on taking over Earth.

Title: 361. War and Peace, Part III: The Year 1812
description: It explores The Battle of Borodino through the eyes of Pierre.

Title: 362. Operation 67
description: The silver masked Santo tries to stop a gang of counterfeiters who conspire to ruin the economy.

Title: 363. First to Fight
description: In WW2, highly decorated Marine Sgt. Jack Connell comes home to the USA from the Pacific War and trains recruits for the army until his fighting spirit prods him to request a return to active duty on the front lines.

Title: 364. Fearless Frank
description: A satirical comedy about an unsophisticated country boy who treks off to Chicago, Illinois, gets shot by mobsters, and awakens to find that he has the powers of Superman.

Title: 365. The Killing Game
description: Two cartoonists meet a playboy who lives out the fantasies created in their cartoons. He hires them to create a new comic strip. As they work on the new strip, the playboy begins to live it out. Unfortunately, the new strip deals with murder.

Title: 366. The Legend of the Boy and the Eagle
description: This movie is about a young Hopi Indian boy who defies tribal law and frees a sacred, sacrificial eagle. He is banished from his village to the wilderness, but the eagle teaches him hunting skills and cares for him. He eventually returns, and when the other boys in the tribe reject him, the boy runs, climbs to a cliff area and jumps off. Before he reaches the ground, the boy turns into an eagle. At the end, the two eagles fly side by side...one of them wearing a blue-beaded necklace.

Title: 367. Double Suicide: Japanese Summer
description: Over the course of a night, a sex-obsessed young woman, a suicidal man, and a gun-crazy wannabe gangster are taken prisoner of a gang awaiting a shootout between a rival gang at dawn.

Title: 368. Ballata per un pistolero
