description: Raj Singh is the nephew and heir apparent of multi-millionaire J.J. Singh. J.J. Singh has to travel worldwide for business purposes, and he asks Raj to join him in Tokyo. An employee, Pran, who has been asked to take care of Raj's travel needs, decides to sabotage this trip in order to embarrass Raj. When Raj lands at Tokyo, he misses his uncle, who has had a change in plans, and is now in Europe. Raj must re-book his flight to go to Europe. Raj finds that he has no money for an air-ticket, or to go anywhere. All he has is $8 American dollars, which will not even be able to buy him a meal in Japan, leave alone travel anywhere.

Title: 640. A Ghost of a Chance
description: Three children try to fight against the destruction of a local historic landmark. They are helped by a group of friendly ghosts.

Title: 641. Only a Coffin
description: A doctor invites his relatives to his castle, all the while planning to murder them when they arrive. However, when he himself is found murdered, the relatives know they have to find the killer before he gets them all.

Title: 642. The Hookers
description: The story of three women and the circumstances that led each to get involved in prostitution as call girls.

Title: 643. La peur et l'amour
description: "Love + fear = Torment" is one of the most erotic and sensual films ever to be imported from France by Olympic International Films. It was only because of the significant social importance of this picture that U.S. Customs authorities allowed such a startling picture to be admitted into this country. It shows in infinite detail, the raw realistic side of French life, and should be one of the year's top box office draws. "Love + fear = Torment" exposes the secret world of the French model studios, and the men who try to corrupt them. Mobsters become involved when fifty-thousand dollars worth of uncut gems are stolen. A model studio becomes terrorized as one of the models innocently befriends one of the mobsters.

Title: 644. Mehrban
description: A wealthy businessman's family faces ruin when he loses everything. After two sons abandon them and a wedding is canceled, he dies. His wife is dying as their mansion faces auction, leaving the family desperate for a miracle.

Title: 645. The Viscount
description: Clint de la Roche is an insurance agent of royal decent. This regal playboy is known around the world for his ruthless gun totting methods in sorting out insurance problems.

Title: 646. Bhakta Prahlada
description: A devotee of Lord Vishnu attempts to share his faith with his skeptical father.

Title: 647. Onkel Joakims hemmelighed
description: A crime boss wants the pub Trinidad in Nyhavn, Copenhagen, but Joakim doesn't want to sell and the pub's regulars are opposed, too. His niece inherits the pub if she'll run it. What about her fiance, the regulars, and the crime boss?

Title: 648. La isla de los dinosaurios
description: A group of scientists in search of lost Atlantis are plane wrecked on an uncharted island inhabited by monsters of the prehistoric era.

Title: 649. Utek
description: Children who were smoking are suspected of setting fire to a wooden warehouse, and little Sasha is among those under investigation. Because he is afraid to return home, he runs away together with an older teenager.

Title: 650. Professor Lust
description: A chemistry professor experiments with a substance that turns him into a swinger.

Title: 651. The Second Wife
description: A corrupt mayor, who rules the village's people with power and injustice, forces another poor man's wife secretly to marry him in order to have a child.

Title: 652. Un homme à abattre
description: Barcelona, 1967. Hans Fromm, a German-born architect, lives an well-ordered everyday life. He has become the target of an antifascist death squad though. Indeed their leader, Julius, whose brother was killed by Schmidt, a merciless S.S., believes, without being absolutely certain, that Fromm and Schmidt are the same man. The team, whose other members are Georges, the son of a deportee liquidated by Schmidt craving for action, Raphaël, a mercenary type, Nils, the photographer and Romain, watch Fromm's every move until Julius, convinced at last that the quiet German is their man, gives the green light for the operation. They manage to lure the former Nazi to an old house but Schmidt/Fromm won't let himself be captured so easily...

Title: 653. Jovita
description: A talented athlete falls for a mysterious girl at a fancy-dress party. When she disappears, the boy is desperate to find her.

Title: 654. Spiked Heels and Black Nylons
description: The wife of a policeman, gets hooked on drugs and secretly goes to work at the dreaded club of hidden desires,"Club Lesbo", a seedy sex club patronized and run by gangsters.

Title: 655. Balika Badhu
description: In ancient times in India there was a time when children got married and then when the time comes they live together.This film surely tells the story of that marriage and tells it greatly. In a village circa the British rule in India, lives a young school-going male named Amal, who is shortly to get married to a girl named Rajni.The traditional ritual-filled marriage takes place, the young couple are then left alone for a few days, and this is where the two develop their love and friendship. Then Rajni must return to her parents' house, while Amal continues with his studies in school, and at home with Masterji, an elderly teacher. His life is enlivened occasionally when Rajni is permitted to visit. Rajni next visit is scheduled for Durga Pooja, but she does not come, instead she comes at Vijay Dashami, to stay there for a couple nights, before going on a Tirth Yatra with her family, where they are scheduled to visit all the holy places in India namely, Benaras, Gaya, Mathura, Vrindavan, Hardwar, Nasik, Hrishikesh, Dwarka, Rameshwaram, Kamakshya, Puri, and Konarak. But before that could happen their little world is shattered when the gentle Masterji is arrested by the police for being a "Freedom-fighter", harboring and training fugitives, and making explosives. Watch whether this incident will affect Amal and Rajni or otherwise.

Title: 656. Keluarga 69
description: A father and son business team is estranged when the son is thrown out of his home. He then teams up with a kindly former tenant who helps him become a successful singer but not without a few rough patches along the way. Mismatched romance alliances within the family makes up for a hilarious reconciliation.

Title: 657. Amor en el aire
description: An Argentine on the flight to Spain causes so much trouble for a stewardess that she is fired. She decides to try her luck with an artist representative. There you will meet the guy who got you fired.

Title: 659. Dio non paga il sabato
description: Good Samaritan drifter, Benny Hudson, and a stranded woman, Jenny, find themselves being tortured; when they accidentally walk into a gang's hideout in a ghost town.

Title: 660. Teenage Mother
description: A new health teacher in a high school is nearly raped by drug-dealing students and is blamed when a student turns up pregnant.

Title: 661. O Homem Nu
description: A man gets locked outside of his apartment naked.

Title: 662. Abnormal Blood
description: A police detective, after learning that a rapist he just arrested shares the same ancestral village as him, proceeds to narrate its dark history of rape, violence and vengeance.

Title: 663. The Promiscuous Sex
description: Liz is a New York prostitute/model whom tries to go straight by having an affair with a nice guy, named Michael, only to have her employer, Sam, and his mafia connections refuse to let her leave the business.

Title: 664. El asesino se embarca
description: Cops vs counterfeiter on a cruise ship from La Paz, Baja California to Mazatlán, Sinaloa.

Title: 665. The Money Jungle
description: When four geologists who form a combine of five industrial companies are murdered, a trouble-shooter is hired to find himself in a net of deadly intrigue and treachery. The prize: a field to be leased to private industry by the state.

Title: 666. Rancho solo
description: The film is a typical whodunit story, combined with a "ranchero" and western flavor. A young engineer arrives to his godfather hacienda, along with his fiancée. But the things got complicated when the godfather's wife reveals that she had an affair with the young man. One night, the young man's father is murdered in the wood, and he will look for revenge.

Title: 667. Le grand dadais
description: A young man with a large inheritance falls in love with a photographer's model.

Title: 668. Dubravka
description: A coming of age drama. Dubravka, a teenage girl who lives in a resort town by the Black Sea, approaches adolescence.

Title: 669. Spia spione
description: Carlo Barlozzetti, a silly waiter, lives alone in an apartment located across a bank which a Professor and his followers try to robe. While The Professor intends to steal a ring packed with a precious and secret metal alloy guarded in A safety deposit box, his men want to take the money from the safe.

Title: 670. Aman
description: Meloda (Saira Banu) who was educated in India, speaks Hindi; though she is Japanese. Dr. Gautamdas (Rajendra Kumar) is a UK trained doctor who volunteers to go to Japan to help deal with the horror of the radiation aftermath of Hiroshima and Nagasaki. They meet in Japan and the inevitable happens when hero meets heroine. Lord Bertrand Russell in London, gives Gautam his blessings and best wishes for his travel to Japan. Russell , a pacifist and anti-war thinker (who appears in a cameo role) sets the tone of this 1967 film. On arrival in Japan Dr Gautamdas takes up a role in a hospital where Meloda's father Dr Akhira (Chetan Anand) is director. The storyline takes us through the stark and sometimes gory suffering that radiation victims endured; as a stark reminder of the long term damage caused by atomic weapons. A majority of the shoot sequences are in Japan, with director Mohan Kumar taking artistic liberties in switching from the Ginza strip, with pan shots of the Mitsubishi tower, the Hokkaido and with glimpses of Mt. Fuji. A scenic gondola ride, ski fields are all part of the package. Lata Mangeshkar's rendering of the fusion song "aisuru" is set to a musical score that is drawn from both cultures Shankar. Mohammed Rafi sings a few forgettable, but apt to the storyline songs. A group of fishermen are exposed to radiation from French nuclear tests in the Pacific, Dr Gautamdas mounts a daring rescue to help save the fishermen. Battling angry elements Dr Gautamdas helps the fishermen survive, saving every last one of them - but at what cost? When viewed in the context of India-Japan relationship, beginning with the arrival of Buddism in Japan, formation of the Indo-Japan Society in 1905, Japan's support for Subash Chandra Bose's INA this film takes on a meaning beyond a love story. It is a cry against the horrors of atomic weapons, the enduring damage they inflict and martyrdom for a cause.

Title: 671. Per amore... per magia...
description: There was once upon a time the Grand Duchy of Forilalì where Aladdin lived. After taking part in many robberies, he decided to turn honest for the love of the beautiful Princess Esmeralda. But his intention lasted only a few days. Afterward he found himself in jail with his old companions. They were freed by the magician Magrebì and in a night of lunar eclipse, Aladdin found a magic lamp. He succeeded in cleaning his sister Adalgisa's house with the help of the genie and then, with no help at all, to marry Esmeralda. But evil powers were in action.

Title: 673. La loi du survivant
description: In 1960, Stan, the protagonist, after having made a fortune in Asia, returns to Corsica, to visit a friend's tomb. In Ajaccio, he meets Helene, who she rescues from her kidnappers, who take advantage of her "charms" in a house of ill reputation. They hide then somewhere in the mountains, where they are pursued by the Corsican mobsters...

Title: 675. Three Seconds Before the Explosion
description: A lightning-paced 60's crime film from Japan's Nikkatsu Studios, 3 SECONDS TO EXPLOSION packs enough subterfuge and action into its 84 volatile minutes to fill out a dozen pictures made anywhere else.

Title: 676. Lamiel
description: The story follow young orphan Lamiel as she rises from poverty into high society under the guidance of a doctor, who lives vicariously through her.

Title: 677. La perra
description: A troubled sailor agrees to rent his yacht to a writer and his wife for a trip from Buenos Aires to Punta del Este. As they journey together, dangerous passions arise between two of the travelers.

Title: 678. Whip's Women
description: JOHNNY WHIP, an extremely rich letch who owns the CLASSIC CAT nightclub, is found dead. He is floating face down in his swimming pool, with a silver corkscrew in his throat. Four women were living with Johnny Whip in his luxurious home; and all were at the wild party where he was killed. Why didn't they see it? Police Detective Parker questions the four to see what kind of a man Johnny Whip was; and to find out WHO KILLED JOHNNY WHIP? SALLY found the body, she worked as an exotic dancer in his club. Whip ordered her to make one of his underworld friends a happy man. She refused saying, "I don't belong to you." Whip and his henchman Maxwell drag her to a tattoo parlor, and from then on she was: "Property of John Whip." He drapes his love slave in mink, but forces her to massage him with a vibrator while the housekeeper, Kate, takes Video Tape pictures of their exotic activities. Sally says, "he was a fiend, and I'm glad he's dead." Other women in the clan reveal their details... the movie ends with a surprising revelation!

Title: 679. The Man Who Was Worth Millions
description: Jean Sarton is a secret agent who was sent to jail to get in touch with a professional counterfeiter who was making false bank notes for the Nazis during the Second World War.

Title: 680. Kolonaki: Diagogi miden
description: The purchase of an apartment in Kolonaki (luxury suburb of Athens) from a big-time butcher faces reactions from the rest of the people leaving there, who consider themselves as "nobles".

Title: 681. El romance del Aniceto y la Francisca
description: Aniceto is used to being lonely. When Francisca offers him her true love, his personal limitations and little miseries arise.

Title: 682. The Last American Hobo
description: A look at the history of American hobo life.

Title: 683. The Blue Beads from Greece
description: A rich girl causes problems in a traditional, folk neighborhood of Athens when she opens a shop that plays modern music.

Title: 684. Ooty Varai Uravu
description: Ravi, the only son of Vedachalam (Baliah), has traveled on business. Returning home, he meets a young woman on the train after picking up her spilled luggage. The contents of the luggage reveal that she is his sister, from his father's teenage years. When he returns home, she is moved in and living a life of wealthy luxury. But is she really who she says she is?

Title: 685. The Clown and the Kids
description: A small circus troupe wants to perform for the children in a small Eastern European town, but is prevented from doing so by the evil town boss. The circus' clown and his colleagues come up with a plan to defeat the boss and his men and put on a show for the kids.

Title: 686. Makedonska krvava svadba
description: The film is the story of girl Cveta who was abducted by the Ottoman bey and taken away in his harem. Bey is trying to embrace Islam, but its persistence, and its neighbors led beloved Spasa, and beloved local priest, assisted by diplomats of the great powers manage to free themselves. On the day of her wedding comes Bey with his army to try to get it back. Cveta dies, Spasa killing Bey and and goes to the committees.

Title: 688. Run Swinger Run!
description: After an assault, a young woman flees home and joins an LA escort service run by the mysterious Schneider. When she uncovers his dark secret, Laura becomes the target of a deadly sniper.

Title: 689. Badrinath Yatra
description: Due to her son's, Devdutt's arrest, Satyavati is unable to take the Badrinath Yatra. Subsequently, he starts to frequent a brothel to visit with a courtesan, Chandravati, and virtually refuses to do anything with his pregnant wife, Sheila. He even drinks alcohol, and assaults his father, Jaggannath, and brother, Sridhar. Things get even worse when he blinds his mother, lets Chandravati and her entourage move in their family home, and asks Sheila to serve the courtesan.

Title: 690. Bokseri idu u raj
description: Tragicomic story about a former boxing champion, unbeaten in the ring, but beaten by alcohol.

Title: 691. Bir Dag Masali
description: In a small town, it describes the love story between a teacher and a doctor.

Title: 692. The Affair
description: A woman, unhappily married to a cheating executive, starts meeting her dead mother's lover and gets thrown into a romantic dilemma after succumbing to a rough laborer.

Title: 693. Lucky, el intrépido
description: An American secret agent is sent to Europe to track down a ring of counterfeiters. His investigation takes him from Rome to Albania, where he gets involved with a sexy Albanian police commissioner.

Title: 694. Dollar, Welcome
description: With the arrival of the U.S. Navy's Sixth Fleet, a poor English teacher hesitantly accepts a cabaret owner's lucrative offer to teach the basics of the language to two of her best girls. But, what if one of them is only interested in love?

Title: 695. Operation Third Form
description: School children save an old junk collector from being accused of a theft and try to prevent his partner from stealing a valuable painting.

Title: 696. Kaule
description: Eleven-year-old Kaule lives with his aunt in Hinrichsfelde, a small village located in Mecklenburg. The smart and animated boy constantly comes up with plans that are supposed to help others. Since they usually go awry, however, most of the time his fellow men have a hard time appreciating these plans. Things get even worse when Kaule meets Karola, a girl who is new in the village.

Title: 697. Resan
description: Together with his younger brother Torbjörn, Thomas got to accompany his father to Copenhagen on the other side of the strait and visit Tivoli and Dyrehavsbakken. It was a day full of sun and joy, but it also came with the news that the father had to leave his pilot position in Malmö and move to Stockholm. His trachea could not withstand the sea air. Thomas thinks back at his father's funeral. He is now coming out of puberty but is still emotionally tied to his father and childhood memories.

Title: 698. Las 4 bodas de Marisol
description: Marisol is a movie star who is about to marry the director of her latest film. The wedding ceremony is interrupted by three men who claim to be engaged to marry the actress.

Title: 699. No Diamonds for Ursula
description: Spiros has summoned five criminals of different nationalities to his house in Rome to carry out a major hit on a jewelry store.

Title: 700. Raat Aur Din
description: Varuna is seen singing and dancing in a nightclub with a stranger, Dilip; suddenly Partap arrives and confronts her, stating that he is her husband. But she claims that she never married and her name is Peggy, which leads to a tiff between Dilip and Pratap, which Varuna manages to escape. The next morning Pratap confronts her about the night before, but she denies knowing anything and claims she was in the house all night. Dilip arrives to apologize saying he was with Varuna in the club last night. Pratap and Dilip decide to take medical assistance from Dr Dey and Dr Alvares and find that it could be a mental disorder of Varuna having two personalities, and to figure out a solution they should find her past. Pratap tells the doctors how he met Varuna in Shimla and got married and never came across anyone called Peggy, while Dilip just saw her for a few minutes at a party in Shimla a few years back and knows nothing beyond that. Varuna is kept under observation where doctors examine her when she turns into Peggy at night and does not remember anything when she is Varuna during the day. Varuna's condition worsens while Pratap loses his patience and his cool on her; to make it worse, Varuna goes missing from the hospital while Peggy remains a mystery.

Title: 701. Sor Citroen
description: A community of nuns in charge of an asylum for orphan girls decides to get motorized. They buy the vehicle and Sister Tomasa will have to drive it. She will soon be known around Madrid as Sor Citroen.

Title: 702. La muchachada de a bordo
description: The adventures of two conscripts on an aircraft carrier including the rivalry of one of them with an officer for a woman.

Title: 703. Case of the Naves Brothers
description: The innocent brothers are wrongly accused of a crime by a corrupt and violent police officers and are forced to face the injustices of the brazilian penal system.

Title: 704. Madame O
description: A teenage girl walking along the beach is attacked by a group of men and brutally gang-raped. She later finds out that not only is she pregnant from the rape, but that she has contracted syphilis, and she develops a deep hatred for all men. Years later she becomes a doctor. By day she saves lives, but at night she takes her revenge on men by picking them up and killing them in various ways. However, one day she meets and falls in love with a young physician. Complications ensue.

Title: 705. The Magnificent Texan
description: Manuel Lopez is a tough, gun-wielding saloon owner who helps Mexican peasants oppose a notorious land baron who is cruelly oppressing them.

Title: 706. ¡Adios cuñado!
description: Five orphan siblings navigate the world of romance. Victor, the eldest, feels the need to defend his four beautiful sisters from suitors all the while trying to romance a young lady himself.

Title: 707. Birth Control Revolution
description: The insane gynecologist Dr. Marukido Sadao theorizes that a woman is unable to become pregnant if she is writhing in intense pain during intercourse. He sets about testing this new method of birth control by torturing women during sex.

Title: 708. El centauro Pancho Villa
description: Mexican revolutionary Pancho Villa is impressed by the beauty of a woman, and a former property owner feels jealous.

Title: 709. People Meet and Sweet Music Fills the Heart
description: It's a story of fire and play. About women and men. About life and death. About the marvelous legality of coincidences. It's a story of love--heavenly, mortal, and devilish love.

Title: 710. Killer Kid
description: The ruthless and cruel Captain Ramirez hunts down and kills revolutionaries in his search for The Saint, the righteous leader of the Mexican insurrection against the Federales.

Title: 711. Latt Saheb
description: A woodcutter, Jangu lives a poor lifestyle in Kashmir along with his widowed mother, who fears that he is going to die soon after Dassera. She keeps on praying for his well-being and safety, and cautions him to be careful all the time. But Jangu does quite the opposite, gets into fights, even kills a man-eating tiger, and romances his employer's daughter, Nikki, after risking his life and rescuing her twice. Nikki too falls in love with him, much to the chagrin of her estate Manager, Prem, who is the choice of her wheelchair-bound dad. Circumstances will compel Jangu's mother to change her mind about his long life and safety, and she not only curse but also viciously assault, and wish him dead.

Title: 712. Flame and Women
description: A sterile man arranges for his disapproving wife to receive artificial insemination, after which she starts nourishing a strong desire for the child's biological father.

Title: 713. Two Faces of the Dollar
description: A teacher, a hero, an ex colonel and a beautiful woman hatch a plan to rob Fort Henderson. When they succeed their troubles just begins.

Title: 715. I criminali della metropoli
description: The criminals of the metropolis (1967). A gang of vicious drug dealers fights with the police for control of the city.

Title: 716. No Stars in the Jungle
description: The story begins with this man who wants to steal the gold from an old woman. But then, while maintaining a strong allegorical bent, drifts toward a more complex thing, using a labyrinth like narrative that goes back and forth.

Title: 717. The Ernie Game
description: Set in mid-winter Montreal, a mentally unstable young man becomes involved with 2 women, which fuels his paranoia, forcing him to commit criminal acts.

Title: 718. A Rose for Everyone
description: Rosa is a beautiful girl who lives in Rio de Janeiro, works as a nurse and have adventures with several men at the same time.

Title: 719. Gingakei
description: A man searches for meaning in a world he does not recognize, trying to find the purpose of his being there.

Title: 720. Encrucijada para una monja
description: During an uprising in the Belgian Congo, a convent of nuns are besieged and the Reverend Mother is killed and Sister Maria is raped. Returning to Belgium, Sister Maria finds out to her horror that she is pregnant. Rejected by her family and her sister, she is told by the Vatican that she is supposed to either give the baby to the church and still be a nun or keep the baby and leave the order. This film follows her decision.

Title: 721. La malédiction de Belphégor
description: Also called "The Curse of Belphégor", this movie follows a series of murders and disappearances, with all the victims being connected to the great opera of Toulon.

Title: 722. Tom and Jerry Classic Collection Volume 6
723. Sleepy Eyes of Death: A Trail of Traps
description: This film of the sleepy-eyed ronin series has the hero talked into escorting a precious religious artifact to Kyoto, Japan. A sect of Christian swordsmen are lying in wait to steal the statuette. What does it take for the reluctant man to accept the assignment? Why, enjoying the company of a virgin daughter of course.

Title: 724. Night in London
description: When her father is taken hostage, a woman is forced into a life of crime; and soon, everyone is after the priceless necklace in her possession.

Title: 725. Le canard en fer blanc
description: A pilot gets busted in an imaginary South America country and is sentenced to death. He is saved from the fire squad by a bunch of so called revolutionaries.

Title: 726. Perverted Criminal
description: A madman is on the loose, raping and murdering women and sometimes engaging in necrophilia. After one woman manages to flee the criminal she reports the abuse to the police to help in bringing him to justice. The criminal targets the woman for being killed at any price.

Title: 727. Herrliche Zeiten im Spessart
description: The countess is married, and the ghosts are still in the Spessart. Her husband becomes an astronaut and the story involving time and space traveling starts.

Title: 728. The Heroine
description: The film was due to be a one-hour adaptation of an Isak Dinesen story of the same name, from her collection Winter's Tales (1942). It would have starred Oja Kodar as a young French aristocratic widow during the 1870 Franco-Prussian War.

Title: 729. Brigitta
description: A sexually repressed drinking single woman becomes mesmerized by a mysterious charmer who releases her innermost fantasies and appetite for all things erotic.

Title: 730. Mr. Spinster
description: Above all, the confirmed bachelor, Thanassis Baroutsos, loves his freedom, unaware that someone has devised a plan that leads straight to church. The stage is set for the perfect entrapment; but, can Mr Spinster renounce his former self?

Title: 731. The Brightest Star
description: The most beautiful singer in the whole fish market finds herself not only singing at the local nightclub but also working side by side with a handsome, yet sour classical music student. Are they both willing to put aside their differences?

Title: 732. Viva Rena
description: The striking resemblance between two cousins--a popular performer, and a little-known Corfiote singer--will involve the latter in a faithful impersonation to keep the show going at a reception. Can anyone unmask the well-meaning impostor?

Title: 733. La mujer de otro
description: After ten years of marriage and two children, Ana María meets Andrés, an old friend with whom she has always been in love.

Title: 734. C'mon, Let's Live a Little
description: Standard boy-girl malt shoppe doings, with a free speech on campus sub-plot dropped in.

Title: 735. Buenos días, condesita
description: A wealthy man living abroad hires a woman to pose as his girlfriend when his parents come to visit him.

Title: 737. Psychedelic Sex Kicks
description: Two hippie chicks go to a guy's place for a night of LSD tripping and sex. Through inner monologue, they explain in a stream of consciousness fashion what they feel during their long surreal trip.

Title: 738. To Chase a Million
description: A lone shark bounty hunter pits himself against secret agents from three countries. The prize: a million bucks in cash for vital state secrets. A little talky in spots, but overall not bad. Color. 16mm.

Title: 740. Nezabyvaemoe
description: About hardships of the first years of War, which fell to the lot of ordinary people in Ukraine, who got under the yoke of fascist occupation, and heroic struggle against the invaders. A young Ukrainian woman asks a Red Army soldier to spend the night with her in the wake of the Nazi invasion. Fearing she may soon perish, the woman hopes for one night of romance before what could be a horrible demise.

Title: 741. Return of the Prodigal Son
description: Engineer Jan Sebek (Jan Kačer) is undergoing treatment in a mental home after his unsuccessful attempt to commit suicide. His therapist, via discussions both with the patient and with people who know him, tries to find out what made the young and seemingly satisfied man decide to end his own life. Jan's pretty wife Jana (Jana Brejchová) claims not to know about anything but she is conducting an affair with a family friend, almost publicly and with the blessing of her parents.

Title: 742. Cruces sobre el yermo
description: On his way to avenge his murdered father, Juan encounters María and forcefully takes her. Though he offers to make amends after she reveals she can't marry her fiancé Damián, she refuses, loyal to her love. Tragedy follows.

Title: 743. Six Kids and the Honeymooners
description: Fredhvilevej 11 is filled with flowers and gifts, a big event is coming up. Lisbeth Andersen and Erik Lund are to be married.

Title: 744. Un poker di pistole
description: After losing everything in a poker game and finding himself indebted, Lucas agrees to deliver a wagon to the town of Chamaco for the $5000 payment. He soon finds himself in deep trouble with bandits, the town's local kingpin and a pretty saloon worker.

Title: 745. Los chicos con las chicas
description: Mike and his friends make plans for a mountain vacation. Near where they're camping is a girls' school where men are strictly forbidden. But when Mike falls in love with a student, he manages to get into school as a music teacher.

Title: 746. Singapore, Singapore
description: Captain Art Smith and four US Marine volunteers in Singapore investigate the disappearance of other Marines on shore leave in that city and discover that a mad scientist is responsible.

Title: 747. Two a Penny
description: A self-centered boy who deals in drugs and disrespect. A little girl lost who turns to religion for solace. Neither is any good for the other, but neither can leave the other alone.

Title: 749. The Adventures of Juan Quin Quin
description: The metamorphoses of Juan Quin Quin, in turns bullfighter, guerrilla fighter and sacristan.

Title: 750. Black Falcon
description: Zhang is a Bond-like international spy who must find the headquarters of a villainous crime organization by seducing their boss' daughter, Julie Tan.

Title: 751. Savage Justice
description: A Japanese girl arrives in a Canadian coastal town to avenge her father's internment-camp death during the war.

Title: 752. Man of Steel
description: An odd morality tale of a film that falls into three distinct parts. It opens in a steel town where a group of workers oppose the forces of capitalism, then switches to a wilderness adventure and culminates with the story of a number of teens who experiment with booze and drugs but are made to see the error of their ways when they find religion. A Christian movie that does not seem to have reached a wide audience, as it is not listed in The Great Canadian Guide To Movies and TV, which can be found on line.

Title: 753. Dokuzuncu hariciye kogusu
description: Crippled and foot bone damaged young boy Burhan loves Nuzhet. There is someone else, Dr. Ragip who is on the verge of marriage with Nuzhet.

Title: 754. A Time for Burning
description: During the civil rights movement, a Lutheran minister in Nebraska sets out to integrate his church.

Title: 755. Spy Today, Die Tomorrow
description: Millionaire Baretti pays a gang to rob an atomic bomb from an American silo, and then blackmails the USA Government for a huge amount of money. German BND agent "Dynamite" has to use his fists, guns and more in a violent bomb chase.

Title: 756. Ave Kallu
description: Rich and pretty, Susila returns from college to find that her family is being bumped off one by one. The only clues are a half smoked cigar left at the scene of each murder and a mysterious woman in white running through the courtyard.

Title: 757. Burnt Skin
description: Mass inner migration in Spain from Andalusia to Catalonia in the 60s is portrayed in two stages: first the husband, who must adapt to his new country, find work and a place for his family to live. Then his wife and children. Any shock must be overcome by their vital needs.

Title: 758. The Cave of the Silken Web
description: Cave of Silken Web is the third installment in Shaw Brothers series from the Chinese classic tale Journey to the West. The monk Tripitaka and his three protector/companions, Monkey, Pigsy, and Sandy are trapped in the Cave of the Seven Spiders (i.e. seven swimsuit-clad seductresses) who want to eat the monk's flesh to gain immortality.

Title: 759. De trei ori Bucuresti
description: A Romanian film from 1968, consisting of three distinct film stories whose action takes place in Bucharest. The three stories are written and made by three different directors.

Title: 760. Track of Thunder
description: Rivals on the raceway--for publicity purposes only (but secretly buddies). Then they fall in love with the same woman--and the rivalry on the raceway becomes very real...

Title: 762. Monday's Child
description: A married couple uproot their entire family and move to Puerto Rico where the familial tree promptly dies in the face of relentless poverty and depression.

Title: 763. Island of the Lost
description: An anthropologist and his family are shipwrecked on a South Seas island.

Title: 764. The Violent Ones
description: A Hispanic town's girl is attacked and says her attacker was white before falling comatose. The sheriff arrests all outsiders, hoping for a confession or her ID, while her father readies a lynch mob.

Title: 765. Aybolit-66
description: A fantasy story based on Kornei Chukovsky classics about a brave doctor Aybolit and his adventures on the land and on the sea.

Title: 766. Buckaroo: The Winchester Does Not Forgive
description: Al arrives in town which is ruled by Lash who has taken possession of one gold mine and is now aiming to get the other which is owned by old Johnny. Al is the only one to support Johnny but still the old man is ambushed and killed.

Title: 767. Kitosch, the Man Who Came from the North
description: A former Canadian Mountie escorts a group of women and coffins to Fort Eagle, but finds it destroyed and remains to defend the fort from a gang of marauding Indians and outlaws led by the mysterious Renegade who are after a shipment of gold bullion.

Title: 768. Diary of a Swinger
description: Jeannie relates her life story to her shrink.

Title: 769. Las amiguitas de los ricos
description: On Christmas Eve, Santa Claus engineers a miracle that will rehabilitate three kept women into orthodox 'decency' and marriage.

Title: 770. V gorode S.
description: "In the City of S." is a Soviet film adaptation of one of Anton Pavlovich Chekhov's most famous short stories "Ionich". This is a story about a young promising doctor Dmitry Ionich Startsev, who moves to a county town where he was appointed a doctor. At first, the life of a budding newcomer in these parts was literally in full swing. He had a lot of new acquaintances and discoveries ahead of him. He met the Turkins, a well-known family in these parts, who were known in the district for their education. Over time, he began to visit them often, where he fell in love with the young Ekaterina Turkina. However, the ambitious girl did not want to stay further in the province and went to Moscow to enter the conservatory, refusing Startsev's offer. Ionich remained where it all began, sinking more and more into the abyss of a well-fed and sluggish existence.

Title: 771. Den onda cirkeln
description: A young woman, Maria, is processing her life trauma. She travels head-first to a small village and finds shelter at an inn, inhabited by a dysfunctional family. Marias arrival stirs a lot of emotion...

Title: 772. You've Got to Be Smart
description: A slick conman finds a singing teenage preacher in a small town in Arkansas and brings him to Los Angeles, where he sets him up with his own show and waits for the money to come pouring in.

Title: 773. The Spy in the Green Hat
description: U.N.C.L.E. agents Napoleon Solo and Ilyia Kuryakin are sent to stop a T.H.R.U.S.H. employed ex-Nazi scientist from diverting the Gulf Stream.

Title: 774. Jaal
description: Inspector Shankar (Biswajeet) is assigned to investigate the mysterious death of Sunder Singh (Sujit Kumar). During this process, he meets a beautiful young and rich heiress named Sheil (Mala Sinha), who has an impaired memory, and is being looked after by Sunder Singh's aunt (Nirupa Roy). He falls in love with Sheila. Sheila confides in Shankar that she thinks she is haunted by a scarred-faced man. As the investigation progresses, Shankar gets the feeling that the results will change their lives forever.

Title: 775. Les compagnons de la marguerite
description: Jean-Louis Matouzec works for French National Library as an expert looking after the restoration of old manuscripts.He falsifies marriage certificates as his wife refuses divorce.

Title: 776. Colt in the Hand of the Devil
description: Scott infiltrates in the cove of the outlaw El Condor, who's spreading fear through the Mojave region, attacking the convoys of gold searchers reaching

Title: 777. C.I.D. 909
description: A wealthy Indian scientist known as Professor has developed a nuclear project to bring about peace in the world. He has encrypted this project in code words known only to him and his daughter, Reshma. Then Wong abducts his wife, Paro, and blackmails the professor. The Professor is ready to turn over the project to Wong, when Wasco abducts Reshma and holds her for ransom in exchange for the same project. C.I.D. Agent Raju steps in and rescues Reshma and both fall in love with each other. But their problems are far from over as Reshma gets abducted again - this time by both Wong and Wasco. Raju search for Reshma lands him in a dungeon - paving the way for the criminals to force the professor to handover the project as well as the solution to the secret code to them.

Title: 778. Cala naprzód
description: Two friends from army meet in harbour. It begins raining. Both protect oneself before rain. Janek begins telling sea adventures. First tells about meeting with actress who proposes him part in film. Second happens on ship where drugs was smuggled. Third tells about angry journalist and a joke about U-Boat. Fourth happens in harem in Casablanca where Janek meets Polish girl. She want to escape and he try to help her.

Title: 779. To Turn a Trick
description: Working late one night at her job as a photographer's assistant, Inger is raped by a client while two nude models force her to submit. Overwhelmed by shame, she runs away and attends a party where drugs stimulate unrestricted sexual activity. Emotionally unstable, Inger turns to lesbianism. She is drawn deeper into a life of depravity, until she is killed by an overdose of drugs.

Title: 780. J'ai tué Raspoutine
description: Grigori Rasputin becomes a fixture of Russia's Imperial Court after saving the life of Alexei Nikolaevich, Tsarevich of Russia, the haemophiliac heir to the throne. However as war breaks out, Rasputin's enemies see him as a cause and plot fatal revenge against the Russian mystic.

Title: 781. Brødrene på Uglegaarden
description: Dora lives on her big farm in Denmark with her 3 no-good stepsons who want to buy the poor neighboring farm for it's huge, secret deposits of gravel. Unexpectedly, the owner's son returns after years at sea and helps his dad with the farm.

Title: 782. Beyond the Mountains
description: In 1941, two Polish brothers escape a Soviet gulag. Their only escape route is through the impossible mountains of Afghanistan and the KGB is on their tail.

Title: 783. Rustom Sohrab
description: Powerful and mighty Rustom Zabuli (Prithviraj Kapoor) of Iran while on a visit to India,rescues a horse-drawn carriage of Shehzadi Tehmina (Suraiya). Impressed by his strength, the Shehzadi offers to employ him, but Rustom refuses. The Shehzadi has his horse abducted and brought to her palace, Rustom follows. Once there, the Shehzadi confesses her love for Rustom, and Rustom too falls in love with her. They are married with great pomp. Due to war in Iran, Rustom must return to defend his king. The Shehzadi's enemies plot to overthrow her father and her, but Shehzadi manages to escape. She gives birth to a son. She must never reveal her husband's true identity to her son or else he will be killed. So Rustom's son, Sohrab (Premnath) grows up without any knowledge of his mighty and famous father. The Shehzadi's enemies now aware of Sohrab, who has acquired his father's strength and might, plot to make both father and son fight, a fight from which only one man can emerge alive and victorious.

Title: 784. The Adolescent
description: When she finds her mother having sex with her boyfriend, a 13-year-old girl from Tokyo is sent to her aunt; a terrible decision which leads to tensions within the family.

Title: 785. Io non protesto, io amo
description: Caterina, a young teacher, has a hobby of singing and occasionally delights her students.

Title: 786. The Ten Million Dollar Grab
description: A thief (Brad Harris), fakes his death in order to steal a 10 million dollar Diamond from his former employer. He has the gem then he looses it and gets it back through various ploys around Europe. Larry Anderson.

Title: 789. Las Vegas Free-for-All
description: The Crazy Cats, a Japanese musical-comedy group, were showcased a series of comic adventures throughout the 1960s. Las Vegas Free-For-All, one of their most popular movies, featured scenes filmed on location in Las Vegas, Los Angeles, and Hawaii. Appearing with the seven Cats were the lovely Mie Hama and such Japanese musical artists as The Peanuts, The Johnnys, The Drifters, and Jackie Yoshikawa & the Blue Comets.

Title: 790. Haci Murat
description: Russian giaour destroy the whole town and kill the entire Muslim people and Seyh Samil imposes duty to Haci Murad to fight against the whole giaour.

Title: 791. The Looters
description: Morgan, a lapsed burglar, is drugged and shanghaied on board a yacht by beautiful Colleen. When he comes to, the athletic young man learns that Colleen and her friends want him to break open the vaults of a Caribbean island where a ruthless dictator has deposited a treasure stolen from his people. Despite the way he has been treated, Morgan accepts the mission. The group, supported by local resistant fighters, storm the fortress, but Colleen's father gets killed during the attack. The treasure is finally retrieved and is returned to the people. Morgan and Colleen will say yes to each other for better or for worse.

Title: 792. Way Out Topless
description: An examination of the "go-go" scene, including topless dancers and strippers, in Washington, DC, and Baltimore, Maryland.

Title: 793. The Sky-Bike
description: This Children's Film Foundation story is about Tom, a boy with his head in the clouds who wishes he could fly. But a chance encounter with a Mr Lovejoy at an abandoned airfield helps Tom realise his dream as the amateur inventor is out to build the first man powered flying machine - the Sky-Bike! Will the two of them get it off the ground? Or will they be beaten by an unscrupulous Squadron Leader who has plans of his own?

Title: 794. Ji mo de shi qi sui
795. Tres mosqueteros de Dios
description: Three priests resort to desperate long-shots (like quiz-shows) to raise money for their parish.

Title: 796. Hugs and Kisses
description: John is kicked out from home by his girlfriend and moves in with his friend Max. After many entanglements Max's girlfriend Eva begins to favor John over Max.

Title: 797. O Jeca e a Freira
description: In the interior of Brazil, a farmer is responsible for the education of the daughter of one of his settlers. Years later, the girl returns from school with a nun and the farmer does everything to prevent her from know her parents.

Title: 798. Hatey Bazarey
description: A idealist doctor engages in a feud with the son of local landlord for the latter's infatuation over a tribal girl whom he forces to live with her despite her denial.

Title: 799. Sex Club International
description: Secret agent Lucky Bang Bang gets assigned to take down a combination blackmail and prostitution ring run by ruthless businesswoman Carol Kane and her mobster cohorts.

Title: 800. Rocambole contra la secta del escorpión
description: Romcabole battles against an evil sect that plans on taking over the world.

Title: 802. Sefiller
description: The adaptation of Victor Hugo's Les Misérables.

Title: 803. Les Arnaud
description: In the sunny landscapes of Provence ,Henri Arnaud is a conscientious law student who 's got a lovely girlfriend ,Tina .The person who used to pay for his studies dies and the poor young man's disposable funds are low.He asks an antique dealer if he can lend him some money .This shady guy agrees ,but in return for homosexual relations.Henri kills him and runs away.Fortunately ,a good judge ,who bears the same name as him ,comes to his rescue .

Title: 805. Sweet Love, Bitter
description: Loosely based on Charlie Parker's last years, and a portrait of the jazz scene in 1960's New York.

Title: 806. 48 Stunden bis Acapulco
description: A young man pays the amateurish attempt to gain wealth by betraying industrial secrets and securing a place in the fascinating world of jet-set life.

Title: 807. Siavash dar takht-e Jamshid
description: Prince Siyavosh arrives in Turan and falls in love with the princess. The local king's jealous son plots to kill him. The film combines this ancient story with documentary footage of tourists visiting the ruins of Persepolis.

Title: 808. Malkoçoglu - krallara karsi
description: Ali Bey turns back from Mora campaign and then he sees his wife and his men is killed. He takes the road to revenge from Vlad the Impaler.

Title: 811. Réseau secret
description: Chased by the secret services of the whole world, former Nazis goes through plastic surgery to change their faces, hide and regroup, but the network they have reconstituted will eventually be dismantled.

Title: 812. Un dorado de Pancho Villa
description: Un Dorado de Pancho Villa opens on Pancho Villa addressing his faithful at the end of the Mexican Revolution. The story proceeds to follow the return of Aurelio Perez (a Major and one of the elite in Pancho Villa's forces) to his home town. On returning he finds that his mother has passed away and Amalia, the sweetheart he left behind is now married to the town's infamous Don Gonzalo; a deceitful man of power and wealth. Amalia, upset to find she has been tricked into marriage by Don Gonzalo enters into a lethal argument with him. Soon Aurelio is accused of the outcome of this fatality and is arrested by the town's commandant; a friend of the Don with his own grievances against Perez. Maria, an admirer of Perez sets out to help free him from his injustice. When her first plan is foiled, Maria takes matters into her own hands. She rescues Perez although only manages to improve the situation temporarily leaving the commandant hungry in his quest for revenge.

Title: 814. Woh Koi Aur Hoga
description: Gopal visits a hill station and starts to encounter a mysterious women Seema who keeps on disappearing.Once he follows her and reaches a mansion where he is attacked by a ghost.Next day Gopal again finds himself in hotel and meets Seema and tries to unveil the mystery.

Title: 815. The Tomcat
description: Swinging London. Tom is desperate for a little excitement. He's sure the new secretary at the office fancies him. Reality never stands in the way of fantasy for Tom. His girl wants to settle down; his mum won't let him watch telly in peace. After all, he wasn't "brought up a navvy". He keeps clippings of fashion models hidden in a drawer, daydreaming that one is in his bedroom clad only in a negligée. He imagines his barber is a blonde, and that the girl at the grocer's lures him to the back with the cartons. He chats up a nice bit on the bus; she moves to another seat... Tom takes the Tube to Piccadilly. He buys himself a Carnaby St. cap to go with his mod check jacket. But the clerk in the men's shop criticizes Tom's sartorial sense. Tom pictures three birds fawning over him as he tries on a suit, the same way they go wild when he sings lead with the band playing at the discothèque. Or so he could do, if he wanted... Tom meets a posh girl in a saloon bar. Perhaps she'll like one of those "sophisticated" Swedish films...

Title: 816. Wahan Ke Log
description: Armed with laser guns, three-fingered virtually invincible Martians collude with gangsters to invade Earth.

Title: 817. Jaguar
description: The adventures of three young men who leave their homeland Savannah, Niger, and go looking for fortune in Ghana.

Title: 818. Put v 'Saturn'
description: A group of Soviet intelligence officers succeeds in infiltrating the German espionage center Saturn, which carries out subversive activities in the Moscow sector.

Title: 819. The Art of Vision
description: This film is a 'deconstruction' of 'Dog Star Man'. It takes the four 'rolls' of super-fast edited, often poetic, imagery of 'Dog Star Man' and shows them first combined, then each combination of three rolls(=4) then each combination of two rolls (=6) then each individual roll (=4). The 'plot' is of a man who goes up a mountain with a dog to chop down a tree, but he has some unspecified transcendental experience while he is there.

Title: 820. Stasera mi butto
description: The son of an Italian Countess meets a young lady staying at a seaside resort with friends. His attentions are turned when a U.S. celebrity, Lola Falana, comes to town and steals his affections. Marisa, the young lady, thinks she should turn her attention to a professor also staying at the resort, but her friends think otherwise and push her to fight for her young man.

Title: 821. Chatei el marah
description: Mansour entrusts Hossam, the son of one of his friends, to watch his daughter, Noura while on a trip to Ismailia. They fall in love but she finds out that he was hired to follow her. She agrees to get engaged to an unemployed man to get back at Hossam.

Title: 822. Ombre sur Angkor
description: Based on a dramatic episode of Cambodia's History, in the sixties. It was about a plot fomented from the outside and in the Angkor-Siemreap-Kompong Thom region by the CIA, two South-East Asian governments tied to the "chariot" of Imperialism and General "Dap" Chhuon Mchulpich (the Governor and Commander of the Cambodian armed forces of the Angkor-Siemreap-Kompong Thom region), all of them being very dissatisfied with the "neutralist" and anti-imperialist policy of Prince Norodom Sihanouk, Chief of State of the Kingdom of Cambodia, and, more particularly, with the rejection by Sihanouk, in 1963, of the conditional and humiliating U.S. aids.

Title: 823. La voie
description: The Algerian War is seen through the eyes of a group of Algerian freedom-fighters who have been captured and incarcerated in French-run military prisons both in France and Algeria. In addition to attempts at escape, this prison drama also includes propaganda and brainwashing attempts by the French and scenes of torture. In what is possibly the most horrible torture of all, the inmates are forced to listen to broadcast speeches by General Charles de Gaulle. Speeches which illustrate the changing relations between the French and the Algerians.

Title: 824. How to Kill 400 Duponts
description: Dorellik, an Italian contract killer that lives on the French Riviera, accepts a job to kill everyone with the surname Dupont that lives in France for a rich customer which supposedly would allow him to obtain a large inheritance.

Title: 825. Hong Kong Nocturne
description: The tale of a female trio singing and dancing in night city of Hong Kong's everyday life.

Title: 826. La lune avec les dents
description: William, a rebellious outsider, briefly connects with Noëlle, a woman from a wealthier background, as Vogel, a trainee police officer, observes him. Their differences prevent any lasting bond.

Title: 828. Mr. Mari's Girls
description: A rich philanthropist uses his wealth to solve young women's problems.

Title: 829. Johnny Banco
description: A hustler of humble origins steals $200,000 from a gangster and heads to Monte Carlo.

Title: 830. Andromeda Nebula
description: A spaceship from Earth is trapped on the unknown planet. Based on book "Tumannost Andromedy" by Ivan Efremov.

Title: 831. Holy Ghost People
description: A study on a small Pentecostal congregation in Scrabble Creek, West Virginia.

Title: 832. Bonditis
description: Frank Born believes himself to be a secret agent so his psychiatrist prescribes some time away at a relaxing village in the Swiss Alps. The delusional Born gets enmeshed in a secret international summit and is soon pursuing a coveted microfilm.

Title: 834. Det største spillet
description: Dette er bertningen om sørlending Gunvald Tomstad og hans dramatiske opplevelser da han under okkupasjonen måtte ta på seg en byrde som ingen kunne bære uten å bli merket for livet, hvis de i det hele tatt fikk overleve. Ingen spesialister hadde lært den unge Gunvald opp i å mestre det største spillet. Han var amatør i verdens farligste yrke, men kanskje må man i verdens krigshistorie lete lenge for å finne et menneske, som i måneder og år gjennomførte et vellykket dobbeltspill under så grenseløst vanskelige og farlige omstendigheter.

Title: 835. Pecos Cleans Up
description: Three musicians arrive in a Mexican village destroyed by El Supremo and learn, from the only survivor, of the lost treasure of Montezuma hidden in an Aztec temple. Along comes Pecos and the search is on.

Title: 837. Der tapfere Schulschwänzer
description: Young Thomas skipped school and while walking the Berlin streets he notices a house afire and two small children were saved. It was determined to locate this "unknown" boy, but Thomas remained silent for fear of being exposed as a truant.

Title: 838. The Cold Killer
description: José Desman kills his employer Mr. Salazar, a former judge who sentenced his father.

Title: 839. Nachalnik Chukotki
description: A young patriotic man ends up in the on Chukotka right after the civil war, where he intends to spread ideas of justice and equality among the natives, but instead he learns the local capitalist ways.

Title: 840. La muerte es puntual
description: A gang of criminals assaults a hotel and beats several people on the street.

Title: 843. It's a Mad, Mad Vengos
description: Thanasis although he is a simple waiter makes all the easements to operate a tavern. As he prepares for his marriage with the sister of the tavern owners, suffers amnesia and begins wander in Athens.

Title: 844. Las pirañas
description: Ricardo is an executive who has great success with women and behaves almost like a play-boy. His wife, Carmen, an attractive housewife without children, it feels ignored by him and seeks solace from her mother, who proposes Carmen a change in the way she acts in order to do not lose permanently her husband or even fall into madness.

Title: 845. A koppányi aga testamentuma
description: The story is placed in the 16th century, during the Turkish oppression of Hungary. Laszlo Babocsai, a young Hungarian warrior defeats Oglu, the Turkish agha of the Koppány nahiyah (today: Törökkoppány, Somogy county, Hungary) in a duel. In his testament, the agha leaves him his daughter and fortune. Laszlo must protect the girl's treasures from the Walloon mercenaries plundering the county. He goes through countless adventures together with his comrades, and in the end he finds out what the real treasure is.

Title: 846. Pet holek na krku
description: The father of fourteen-year old Natasa is the chairman of the housing department at the Municipal National Committee. His position is probably the cause of the high living standard of his family. Natasa has everything, even a box in the local theatre, but despite all this she is still unhappy. Her parents are never able to find time for her and the group of four of her girl-classmates, to which Natasa would like to belong, envy her and misuse her. Natasa meets a boy named Petr and is going to have her first date with him. But the girls, aware of her date, lock her in the school cloakroom and hypocritically offer themselves to carry a letter of explanation to Petr. But, instead of Natasa's apologies, they write and deliver another letter in which the girl is shamelessly offering herself to him.

Title: 847. Das große Glück
description: Hans-Jürgen wants to start a new life after the wedding of Marika because that's also the end for the ice skating dream couple Kilius-Bäumler.

Title: 848. The Subversives
description: This film relates several disparate storylines, each representing a different type of lifestyle within Italian society at the time, through their common impersonal relationship to a social event of global importance to Italian society at the time: the death and impending funeral of the long-time leader of the Italian Communist Party.

Title: 850. Geroy nashego vremeni
description: In an adaptation of Mikhail Lermontov's classic 19th century Russian novel "A Hero of Our Time", soldier Pechorin battles with love and fate in the Caucasus.

Title: 852. Domingo salvaje
description: Repressed middle-aged Catholic gets into a troublesome relationship with the prostitute next door and her little boy.

Title: 853. The Nutcracker
description: A Polish film adaptation of the beloved Christmas fantasy classic "The Nutcracker and the Mouse King."

Title: 854. Izu no odoriko
description: Kawasaki, a high school student from Ichiko, walks along a mountain path toward Amagi and encounters a troupe of traveling performers. He becomes captivated by Kaoru, a black-haired dancer carrying a drum on her back. Deciding to travel with the troupe to Shimoda, Kawasaki finds that Kaoru also harbors a tender affection for him.

Title: 856. The Playpen
description: A simple hill girl is dumped into the city's vice and "B" girl rackets to be prey of the wolves.

Title: 857. Julie Is No Angel
description: The many sexual adventures and relations of a sophisticated young woman.

Title: 858. Onna no issho
description: One of many Japanese adaptations of Guy de Maupassant's first novel, "Un vie" [A Woman's Life], this film tells the story of a gentle young woman who gradually becomes embittered after marrying a demanding, unfaithful suitor.

Title: 860. Adios, Hombre
description: A man is arrested, tried and convicted for a robbery that was actually committed by someone else. After he gets out of prison, he goes in search of the real robbers.

Title: 861. Begushchaya po volnam
description: The young pianist Thomas Harvey finds the brig "Hurrying through the Waves". After a brawl, Harvey is abandoned alone in a lifeboat, cut adrift from its moorings. By a miracle, a fair maiden appears in the boat. She reassures him. Anglers salvage Harvey. There is a charming girl among them: Daisy. They tell him the legend of the nocturnal rescuer, Frasie Grand, who rushes through the waves. All sailors in distress have regarded her as a symbol. People have raised a monument to her. By the end of the carnival, Harvey sees yet another crime in progress: the demolition of the Monument to the Hurrying through the Waves. He is the only one to confront the rampaging mob. Harvey once again meets the little sweet Daisy who shares his dream.

Title: 862. Detectives o ladrones..? (Dos agentes inocentes)
description: Two bumbling bozos with detective licenses get hoodwinked by a pair of jewel-thieves.

Title: 863. El tesoro de Makuba
description: Cameron Mitchell hunts for treasure in the Polynesian Islands. The Director uses the name Joe Lacy.

Title: 864. Nindu Manasulu
description: Raju, a honest and courageous young man faces a lot of challenges from a criminal minded person Seshu.

Title: 866. The Killing Bottle
description: Two agents of the International Secret Police must prevent a crime organization from assassinating the President of Buddabai and his General.

Title: 867. Bahu Begum
description: On the day of her marriage, the bride goes missing. She ends up in a brothel, compelling her wealthy husband to pretend that all is well to keep the family's honor intact.

Title: 868. The Homely Sister
description: In the Edo period, sisters Oshizu and Otaka have sacrificed their personal happiness to work and care for their ailing father. Otaka falls in love, but can't accept a marriage proposal since her older sister needs to marry first.

Title: 869. El próximo otoño
description: History of love between a pilot of a pleasure craft and a French girl on vacation in Spain. Unfortunately, once the holidays are over, she will have to return to France to start her classes at the university.

Title: 870. El padre Manolo
description: Padre Manolo, priest, magician and singer, starts a private investigation on what seems to be a murder...

Title: 871. La niña del patio
description: An orphan child arrives at a house courtyard where the neighbours must organise a flamenco show to avoid the house from being sold by its owner...

Title: 874. My Dream Boat
description: The film tells a complicated love story. Carmen with Ke, Xiang Yi and Jiyuan. They start as a friend, but somehow a love triangle occur, and the outcome is very tragic.

Title: 875. Bullets Don't Come Back
description: A recently widowed young farmer is mistaken for the notorious leader of a ruthless gang of bandits. Now, a feared convict, the police, and a band of thieves are after him. Can he stay alive, and save his loved ones?

Title: 876. Heisses Pflaster Köln
description: When his younger brother is arrested by the police and convicted, unscrupulous Cologne pimp Paul Keil swears to take revenge on the public prosecutor responsible at any cost. His vendetta gets dangerously entangled in a gang war with a trio of Viennese pimps who intend to claim the city's red light district all for themselves.

Title: 878. Ran salu
description: Cyril is dissatisfied with his introverted fiancée Sujatha. He starts a relationship with the more out-going Sarojini and gets her pregnant. Sujatha meanwhile is fascinated by a wandering Buddhist nun. Due to the pregnancy, Cyril breaks off the engagement having no intention to marry Sarojini. Till the birth of the child he supports her and then leaves her for an older rich woman. Sarojini is distraught and contemplates suicide. Sujatha by this time is planning to become a nun.

Title: 879. Exterminate the Young Boss!
description: Yagoro, a member of the Mino gang and an old friend of Nanjo Take's late father, came to warmly welcome him out of prison. On the train home with Take, Yagoro was stabbed by an unknown assailant. When Take asked, "Who's the culprit?", Yagoro only managed to utter, "Yoroi..." before dying. A distinctive dagger sheath lay beside him. Take began working as a chef at the Kangetsuro restaurant in the town of Suijo while investigating the newly formed Yoroi gang.

Title: 881. The Story of a Discharged Prisoner
description: After being released from prison, Lee was determined to turn over a new leaf and stay away from the underworld. But the gangster boss, One-Eyed Dragon, used Lee's brother as a soft spot to force Lee to comply.

Title: 882. 40 grados a la sombra
description: Summer is here and the most awaited moment of the year: holidays. Jacinto must stay in the office, but vacations mean losing sight of his wife and children and imagining wild nights. For his part, Máximo decides to go to the mountains to see if he can meet some absent-minded foreigner. Finally, Evaristo goes to the beach with the whole family and confirms his opinion that he works much more during the holidays than the rest of the year.

Title: 883. Sadismo
description: This is another "Mondo" look at real-life horrors from around the world. Some footage was international, while other torture scenes were staged in the US.

Title: 884. Hindistan Cevizi
description: Two out-of-luck sailors are joined by a girl they save from a fight in a bar, but she leads them into more hilarious misfortunes, while one of them falls for her.

Title: 885. Makchalo on sannimdeul
description: A group of friends, living amidst personal tragedies and loneliness, slowly split apart as the hopelessness of society becomes increasingly apparent.

Title: 886. From Saigon to Dien Bien Phu
888. Heitai yakuza ore ni makasero
description: Sixth part of the Hoodlum Soldier saga.

Title: 889. The Hostage
description: Pesky little boy Davey Cleaves stows away on a moving truck that's driven by volatile psychopath Bull and his meek partner Eddie. Naturally, Davey finds himself in considerable danger after he's discovered by the two no-count criminals.

Title: 890. John the Bastard
description: A cynical seducer of women discovers he is actually a son of a wealthy Mexican landowner.

Title: 891. The Devil's Man
description: Journalist Mike Harway decides to help his friend Christine in her search for her father, professor Baker, mysteriously disappeared. The investigation brings them to Africa, where as they're traversing a deserted are they're captured and brought to the El Faium abandoned fort. It now hosts a laboratory designed by the twisted mind of Devilman, who dreams of swapping his natural brain with an artificial one that will make him perfect. Very soon prof. Baker will have to proceed with the transplant, after experimenting the procedure on his daughter. Devilman's long-standing henchman Kun however discovers that the transplant success will also mean his downfall, so he allows Mike to escape with the promise that he'll be back with reinforcements. The journalist finds a Tuareg tribe willing to help him. As the Tuareg warriors engage Devilman's guards in combat, Mike attacks the villain, who perishes crashing into the machine he himself built.

Title: 892. Les encerclés
description: Jean-Claude is a student, with Didier, at the Ecole des Hautes Etudes Generales where Violaine, Didier's sister, is a professor of sociology. These young people belong to this upper-class, snobbish bourgeoisie.

Title: 893. King of the Gang
description: Just back from the war, Noboru Ando leads a gang of war vets turned gangster in the US occupied streets of Tokyo.

Title: 895. Feuer frei auf Frankie
description: A secret agent/International playboy who "just happens" to look like a famous scientist, allows himself to be captured by the opposition, in order to thwart their plans. After many car chases and intrigue, he manages to get away with "the secret plans".

Title: 896. La mujer de a seis litros
897. Último encuentro
description: Antonio Esteve is a boy of humble origin who has managed to become a famous flamenco dancer. Now he moves in a comfortable environment, married to the beautiful Elena (a bourgeois to whom he does not pay much attention), and wants to erase his origins and the bitter betrayal he committed against his best friend, Juan.

Title: 899. Paranoia
description: A man is under the illusion he is a wanted war criminal.

Title: 900. The Poor Merchant
description: An honest medical student, who sells newspapers to make ends meet, falls in love with an affluent young woman with big, sad eyes. But, a shameless theft taints his immaculate reputation. Can an orphaned pedlar help him clear his name?

Title: 901. El camino de los espantos
description: A group of people, including Capulina and Viruta, head towards the city by train. A heavy storm interrupts their journey and now they must take a haunted path to reach they city. (English Subtitled)

Title: 902. Il giardino delle delizie
description: The problems, difficulties and thoughts put on by a man during an unusual marital night are compared to the errors of moralistic education and frustrations of childhood. In the morning, he escapes to another woman.

Title: 903. Slave Widow
description: After her husband kills himself, future prospects for the demure and beautiful Mitsuko Fuji look incredibly bleak. Fortunately, her dead husband's largest creditor, Mr. Kito, is there to offer a shoulder to cry on as he offers to settle all her debts. But, sure enough, Kito's charity comes with certain strings attached; namely that Mitsuko becomes his personal sex slave. Things become even more complicated when Kito's son Kazuhiko falls for the helpless widow, throwing into jeopardy his own marriage plans.

Title: 904. The Adventures of Busty Brown
description: Large-breasted private eye Busty Brown is hired to rescue a kidnapped Asian girl, so she gets a job at a sleazy nightclub where she believes the owner is involved in the kidnapping.

Title: 905. Alamat ng 7 kilabot
description: Nando, a known gunslinger is hired to retrieve a treasure in a town unbeknownst to him and his newly banded fellow gunmen is under the constant harassment of an armed gang.

Title: 906. Seis días para morir
description: 1967 Mexican film "Six Days to Die" shows Mexico City life and Chapultepec Forest. Focuses on rabies prevention campaign, promoting pet vaccination to protect humans.

Title: 907. Kristove roky
description: Juraj, a Slovak artist living in Prague, takes stock in his life, realizing that his days pass without purpose. He lives a carefree life. But now he has to choose between two women, between the city and the country, and between creative work and craftsmanship. He has a passion for art but he also has to make a living. Through his relationships with close people, he grows aware of his position and this knowledge helps him to live a more fulfilling and better life.

Title: 908. The Young Warriors
description: In World War II, a tough sergeant is put in charge of a squad of young recruits and assigned to lead them on a mission against the Germans.

Title: 909. Los chicos del Preu
description: A group of young music lovers are about to go to university. Some of them will find their first love or will have to suffer the rigor of an intransigent professor who rarely passes his students.

Title: 910. Wanted Johnny Texas
description: Johnny Texas is recruited by the U.S. Army to find a safe passage for a wagon train and impatient settlers to the West.

Title: 911. Chanoc
description: Chanoc investigates a series of mysterious deaths linked to a gang that extracts uranium.

Title: 912. Iru Malargal
description: The film tells the story of a man who faces upheavals in his life as he is caught between his lady-love and his devoted wife.

Title: 913. A Ghentar si muore facile
description: In order to overturn the government of some exotic country, the rebels decide to hire an experienced American diver (George Hilton). His risky mission: recover from the botton of the sea a treasure, which would provide financial support to their endeavor.

Title: 914. The Winter's Tale
description: King Leontes of Bohemia suspects his wife, Hermione, and his friend, Polixenes, of betraying him. When he forces Polixenes to flee for his life, Leontes sets in motion a chain of events that lead to death, a ferocious bear, an infant left in the snow, young love, and a statue coming to life.

Title: 915. Mördaren - En helt vanlig person
description: People on a train get murdered. Who is the murderer? Everybody on the train is a suspect. One of them is the homosexual dope fiend.

Title: 916. Jeg er sgu min egen
description: A young woman makes her way in the world in the late 1960s.

Title: 917. Jutro
description: The war has ended leaving a deep trace in people. Going through a different conflicts in the first days of peace - dealing with a former enemy's collaborators and executing traitors - a former soldier continues with killing even in peace. So, the war goes on, a struggle within himself and with the people around him.

Title: 918. Keskpäevane praam
description: The events take place in Estonia in a summer in the 1960s. The Boy and the Girl want to go from mainland Estonia to the island of Saaremaa, but they do not have any money to buy the ticket to the ferry. They manage to hide themselves into a lorry that carries hay. Because they are smoking while they are on the lorry, a fire breaks out. The problem is, that the ferry in the middle of the sea.

Title: 919. Massacre Mania
description: A mad scientist provokes murders by hypnotizing his victims through the television. A couple of psychologists helping the police will try to prevent him.

Title: 921. Kozanoglu
description: Hüseyin's father, who is a member of the Kozanoglu tribe, dies when he does not pay the fee requested by the Bey. Upon this situation, Hüseyin takes an oath to avenge.

Title: 922. Jack and the Witch
description: Jack goes for a ride with his animal friends--a bear, a fox and a puppy. He meets a girl who takes them by helicopter to the castle of a witch who turns children into devils.

Title: 923. Romance pro kridlovku
description: A lyrical story about first love, death and disappointment, based on a poem of the same title.

Title: 924. Portrait of Chieko
description: Takamura, poet and sculptor, is married to Chieko, who also has artistic desires. However, she is becoming increasingly aware that she can not match her husband's work.

Title: 925. Femmina
description: While he is trying to escape from a hit man, Carl (Hardy Krüger) is setting up a kidnapping in Beirut. He gets lost on his way, falling in love with Salène, a.k.a. "La grande sauterelle" (Mireille Darc).

Title: 926. Hate for Hate
description: A self-loathing bank robber forms an uneasy alliance with a resourceful Mexican prospector to save his family from a murderous former partner-in-crime.

Title: 927. A Midsummer Night's Dream
description: A ballet version (using Felix Mendelssohn's music) of Shakespeare's play,featuring the New York City Ballet.

Title: 928. Aag
description: Shanker is a young man who lives in a small village community with his mute sister, Durgi, and his mom, Shanti. Shanker's efforts to get Durgi married are all in vain. The local money-lender, Lala, in his early 60s, comes to know about this and proposes to marry Durgi, but is refused, and asked to leave. Lala plots vengeance, and gets his chance to rape Durgi, resulting in the death of Durgi. Shanker hunts him down, and kills him. Lala's death involves the police, and Shanker must run from them. He does so, and joins a gang of dacoits and pledges to be part of their gang, not knowing that in so doing, he will be spending the rest of his life, hiding in caverns and the countryside, unable to see his mother anymore, nor any normal human being, for the rest of his life.

Title: 929. Death on a Rainy Day
description: Two French agents fight a Chinese sect that aims to control the American Secretary of Defence via high-tech medicine, so that he would start a world war.

Title: 930. Three Days and a Child
description: Based on a short story by Abraham B. Jehoshua, the movie follows Eli (Oded Kotler) taking care of an old girlfriend's child for three days. He wants him to get hurt, he worries about him. Will the child survive the three days? Will Eli?

Title: 931. Marked for Love
description: Radio personality Jack interviews prostitutes, asking them to tell his audience how they began her careers. Jill, neglected by her wealthy parents, becomes promiscuous to gain attention and becomes a prostitute when her family cuts off her allowance. Jody, who's husband travels frequently, enjoys sex with other men; he finds out and divorces her and she returns to prostitution as her means of support. Ann, whose mother was also a prostitute, pursues to occupation to support herself and her husband. Teenager Amy enjoys the money and favours older men bestow upon her. Barbara is raped by her drunken stepfather and runs away and becomes a prostitute when her boyfriend rejects her.

Title: 932. Silnye dukhom
description: The true story of the Soviet intelligence officer Nikolai Kuznetsov, who, behind enemy lines in Ukraine, infiltrated Hitler's headquarters, kidnapped the commander of the punitive troops and executed the imperial adviser.

Title: 933. Zärtliche Haie
description: A brother and sister join the navy.

Title: 934. For Love and Money
description: A group of well-endowed women decide to use their "assets" to get ahead in the business world.

Title: 935. El pistolero desconocido
description: The Sheriff of a small town, in his search of a robber bank, gets to another city, working undercover. There, he tooks the place of man recently killed, and falls in love with his widow.

Title: 936. Rocambole contra las mujeres arpías
description: Mexican superhero Rocambole fights a group of female thieves who are under the control of an evil mastermind.

Title: 937. Naunihal
description: The Principal of New Era High School in Panchgani finds an orphan, Raju, who had lost his parents to plague, brings him home, and enrolls him in the school. Raju notices that while every student has parents and visitors, he has no one to call his own. He gets distraught and is assured by the Principal that he does have a relative in Chacha Nehru (Jawaharlal Nehru, the Indian Prime Minister). Raju believes him, and when he finds out through his teacher, Uma, that Nehru will be delivering a speech in Chowpatty, Bombay, he sneaks off in the trunk of a car. Upon arrival he faces harsh realities, his money is almost stolen, and he is befriended by a cynical deranged male, who tells him that Nehru is now a speech-prone politician and is unable to hear what the common citizen has to say. He also tells him that Nehru has left Chowpatty and is at the Government Bungalow. Both take a cab there, but are told that Nehru has departed for Delhi.
